title: FADRW: A Feature-Aware Modulated and Dynamically Reweighted Loss for Few-Shot Linguistic Steganalysis
comment: Accepted by IEEE Signal Processing Letters
summary: The ubiquity of social media platforms facilitates malicious linguistic steganography, posing significant security risks. However, detection is severely hampered by two fundamental issues during model training. Firstly, extreme class imbalance (less than 1% steganographic samples) induces a strong decision bias. Secondly, the invisibility of generative steganography means its features are nearly indistinguishable from benign text; this similarity, compounded by their extreme rarity, leads to severe feature marginalization, where faint steganographic signals are completely overwhelmed. To directly address these optimization-level challenges, we propose FADRW (Feature-Aware Modulated and Dynamically Reweighted Loss), a novel loss function framework engineered for few-shot steganalysis. FADRW employs Dynamic Reweighting to progressively counteract decision bias, and a Feature-Aware Modulation module to structurally reshape the feature space, preventing feature marginalization by enhancing the separability of these subtle features. Extensive experiments on datasets from three real-world social platforms demonstrate that FADRW significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly in the challenging few-shot steganographic sample scenario.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为FADRW的新型损失函数框架，通过动态重加权缓解决策偏差、特征感知调制增强隐写特征可分离性，以解决社交平台恶意语言隐写检测中样本极不平衡和生成式隐写特征微弱导致的优化难题，在少样本场景下显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 社交平台上恶意语言隐写术泛滥带来严重安全风险，但现有检测方法面临两个根本性优化难题：一是极端类别不平衡（隐写样本不足1%）导致强烈决策偏差；二是生成式隐写特征与正常文本几乎不可区分，加之样本极为稀少，导致微弱隐写信号被完全淹没（特征边缘化）。
AI.method: 提出FADRW损失函数框架，包含两个核心模块：1）动态重加权模块，逐步抵消决策偏差；2）特征感知调制模块，从结构上重塑特征空间，增强微弱隐写特征的可分离性，从而防止特征边缘化。
AI.result: 在来自三个真实社交平台的数据集上进行的大量实验表明，FADRW在少样本隐写检测场景下显著优于最先进的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: FADRW损失函数框架能够有效应对极端类别不平衡和特征边缘化挑战，为少样本语言隐写分析提供了一种高性能解决方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 社交媒体平台的普遍性为恶意语言隐写术提供了便利，带来了显著的安全风险。然而，在模型训练过程中，两个基本问题严重阻碍了检测。首先，极端类别不平衡（隐写样本不足1%）导致了强烈的决策偏差。其次，生成式隐写的不可见性意味着其特征与正常文本几乎无法区分；这种相似性，加上其极端的稀有性，导致了严重的特征边缘化，使得微弱的隐写信号被完全淹没。为了直接解决这些优化层面的挑战，我们提出了FADRW（特征感知调制与动态重加权损失），一种专为少样本隐写分析设计的新型损失函数框架。FADRW采用动态重加权逐步抵消决策偏差，并利用特征感知调制模块从结构上重塑特征空间，通过增强这些细微特征的可分离性来防止特征边缘化。在来自三个真实社交平台数据集上进行的大量实验表明，FADRW显著优于最先进的现有方法，尤其是在具有挑战性的少样本隐写样本场景下。

title: Hessian-matching Based Weighting for Attitude Determination Using Short-Range DoA Measurements with IMU Assistance
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Accurate and reliable attitude determination (AD) is essential for unmanned vehicles operating in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-denied environments. Short-range wireless arrays can provide direction-of-arrival (DoA) measurements from multiple anchors, enabling AD by aligning corresponding direction vectors (DVs) expressed in the body and navigation frames. In short-range scenarios, navigation-frame DVs inherit non-negligible uncertainty induced by anchor/vehicle position errors in addition to DoA-induced errors in body-frame DVs. Moreover, due to projection and unit-norm normalization, the DV errors are generally anisotropic, which motivates a total least squares (TLS) viewpoint. This paper identifies the key modeling distinction in short-range AD, develops a TLS-consistent formulation based on the total DV error and solves the resulting covariance-weighted orthogonal Procrustes problem via a manifold Gauss--Newton method. To retain the efficiency and numerical robustness of the closed-form weighted Wahba solution, we further propose Hessian-matching based scalar weighting strategies that approximate the Hessian of Wahba formulation to the TLS formulation, including a full-attitude strategy for overall accuracy and a direction-of-interest (DOI) strategy for prioritizing a selected attitude component. Finally, we incorporate IMU-derived gravity as an additional DV pair for static initialization, leading to extended Wahba and extended TLS formulations. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed Hessian-matching weighting improves accuracy and robustness compared with existing baselines, and that gravity-DV augmentation further reduces attitude errors and improves solution availability under limited anchor availability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于全最小二乘（TLS）的短距离姿态确定方法，通过Hessian匹配的标量加权策略逼近TLS解，并引入IMU重力矢量辅助，显著提升了GNSS拒止环境下无人系统的姿态估计精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 在GNSS拒止环境中，短距离无线阵列提供的到达角（DoA）测量用于姿态确定时，导航系方向矢量受锚点/载体位置误差影响显著，且方向矢量误差各向异性，现有方法未能有效建模这些误差。本文旨在建立符合TLS视角的优化框架，并兼顾计算效率与数值鲁棒性。
AI.method: (1) 识别短距离AD中导航系方向矢量误差不可忽略的特性，建立TLS一致性的优化模型；(2) 通过流形上的高斯-牛顿法求解协方差加权正交Procrustes问题；(3) 提出基于Hessian匹配的标量加权策略（全姿态策略和关注方向策略），使闭式Wahba解的Hessian逼近TLS解；(4) 引入IMU重力矢量作为额外方向矢量对，扩展为扩展Wahba和扩展TLS公式。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明：所提出的Hessian匹配加权方法相比现有基线方法在精度和鲁棒性上有显著提升；重力矢量增强进一步降低了姿态误差，并在锚点数量有限时提高了解的可获得性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的TLS一致性框架配合Hessian匹配加权策略，能够有效处理短距离AD中方向矢量误差的各向异性问题，且重力矢量的引入可作为有效的静态初始化手段，提升系统在受限条件下的性能。
AI.abstract_zh: 对于在GNSS拒止环境中运行的无人系统而言，准确可靠的姿态确定至关重要。短距离无线阵列可提供来自多个锚点的到达角测量，通过对齐机体坐标系和导航坐标系中表达的方向矢量来实现姿态确定。在短距离场景下，除了机体坐标系方向矢量中由DoA引起的误差外，导航坐标系方向矢量还会继承由锚点/载体位置误差引起的不可忽略的不确定性。此外，由于投影和单位范数归一化，方向矢量误差通常是各向异性的，这促使采用全最小二乘的观点。本文识别了短距离姿态确定中的关键建模区别，基于总方向矢量误差建立了TLS一致性公式，并通过流形上的高斯-牛顿法求解所得的协方差加权正交Procrustes问题。为保留闭式加权Wahba解的效率和数值鲁棒性，我们进一步提出了基于Hessian匹配的标量加权策略，使Wahba公式的Hessian逼近TLS公式，包括用于整体精度的全姿态策略和用于优先考虑选定姿态分量的关注方向策略。最后，我们引入IMU导出的重力矢量作为额外的方向矢量对用于静态初始化，从而得到扩展Wahba和扩展TLS公式。仿真结果表明，与现有基线方法相比，所提出的Hessian匹配加权方法提高了精度和鲁棒性，且重力矢量增强进一步降低了姿态误差，并在锚点可用性有限的情况下提高了解的可获得性。

title: Optimal Wiener-Filter Solutions for Denoising of Graph Signals on Directed Graphs
comment: This work was accepted to be presented at the Graph Signal Processing Workshop 2026
summary: Graph signal processing has opened new avenues to the canonical denoising problem in interesting settings. Specifically, here we propose a Wiener-filter solution for graph signals on directed graphs. Under various stationarity assumptions combining uncorrelated and correlated noise conditions, we show optimal solutions, including a successful proof-of-concept for temperature graph.

AI.tldr: 本文针对有向图上的图信号去噪问题，提出了维纳滤波解决方案，并在不同平稳性假设（包括不相关和相关噪声条件）下给出了最优解，通过温度图数据验证了概念可行性。
AI.motivation: 图信号处理为经典去噪问题开辟了新途径，但现有方法多针对无向图，缺乏对有向图场景下维纳滤波器的系统研究。
AI.method: 基于图信号处理框架，在有向图上提出维纳滤波去噪方法，考虑了不相关和相关噪声条件等多种平稳性假设，推导出最优解。
AI.result: 在不同平稳性假设下（不相关噪声和相关噪声条件）推导出了最优解，并在温度图数据上成功完成了概念验证实验。
AI.conclusion: 提出的有向图维纳滤波器在多种噪声条件下均能获得最优去噪效果，温度图上的概念验证表明了该方法的有效性。
AI.abstract_zh: 图信号处理为经典去噪问题开辟了新途径。具体而言，本文针对有向图上的图信号提出了一种维纳滤波解决方案。在结合不相关和相关噪声条件的多种平稳性假设下，我们给出了最优解，并在温度图上成功完成了概念验证。

title: A Double Proportionate Sparse Adaptive Filter for Impulsive Noise Environments
summary: Sparse adaptive filters and impulsive noise robust algorithms have largely been developed along separate tracks, leaving a gap when both properties are needed simultaneously. This letter proposes the double proportionate sparse adaptive filter (DP-SAF), which closes this gap within a single $\mathcal{O}(M)$ update. Two independent diagonal gain matrices are introduced; one scales the adaptation step proportionately to coefficient magnitudes, and the other applies a magnitude-dependent zero-attraction that is strongest for inactive taps. A sign-error update provides robustness against impulsive corruptions. Both gain matrices are derived from a minimum-norm optimization framework. Simulations under a Bernoulli impulsive noise model show that DP-SAF consistently achieves a better steady-state MSD than the competing algorithms while matching or exceeding their convergence speeds.

AI.tldr: 提出双比例稀疏自适应滤波器(DP-SAF)，通过两个独立对角增益矩阵在单一O(M)更新中同时实现稀疏自适应和脉冲噪声鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏自适应滤波器和脉冲噪声鲁棒算法各自独立发展，缺乏同时满足稀疏性和脉冲噪声鲁棒性需求的算法。
AI.method: 引入两个独立对角增益矩阵：一个按系数幅度成比例缩放自适应步长，另一个对非活跃抽头施加幅度依赖的零吸引；采用符号误差更新实现脉冲噪声鲁棒性；基于最小范数优化框架推导增益矩阵。
AI.result: 在伯努利脉冲噪声模型下，DP-SAF在稳态MSD上持续优于竞争算法，同时匹配或超越其收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: DP-SAF以计算复杂度O(M)高效填补了稀疏自适应与脉冲噪声鲁棒性之间的空白。
AI.abstract_zh: 稀疏自适应滤波器和脉冲噪声鲁棒算法长期以来沿着两条独立的轨迹发展，导致当需要同时具备两种特性时存在空白。本文提出双比例稀疏自适应滤波器（DP-SAF），以单一的O(M)更新填补了这一空白。该算法引入两个独立的对角增益矩阵：一个按系数幅度成比例缩放自适应步长，另一个对非活跃抽头施加最强的幅度依赖零吸引。符号误差更新提供了对脉冲破坏的鲁棒性。两个增益矩阵均源自最小范数优化框架。在伯努利脉冲噪声模型下的仿真表明，DP-SAF在稳态均方偏差上持续优于竞争算法，同时匹配或超越其收敛速度。

title: The Need for Neural ISP in the Small-Pixel Era: How Shrinking Pixels Push Optics to the Limit and Neural Restoration Pushes Back
summary:
Smartphone telephoto cameras are approaching a "telephoto physics wall": as pixel pitches shrink toward sub-0.5 micron, the optics remain limited by geometric aberrations, leading to diminishing returns on resolution. Traditional Image Signal Processors (ISPs) cannot eliminate these aberrations, because they operate through local, stage-wise processing with no explicit model of the underlying point spread function (PSF). We demonstrate how a learning-based Neural ISP for image restoration, trained on the underlying degradations, inverts what stage-wise pipelines cannot, turning small-pixel designs into a net advantage.
  We investigate this through a controlled simulation of a representative telephoto module, evaluating five configurations (0.35--0.75 micron pixel pitch). The aperture is scaled proportionally to keep per-pixel SNR and diffraction spot size fixed, thereby isolating geometric aberration and spatial sampling. While the traditional ISP improves only modestly with smaller pixels, the Neural ISP scales substantially: at 0.35 micron} it reaches 745 cycles/mm MTF50 (vertical), a 2.5--3x resolution improvement over the traditional ISP, and LPIPS improves significantly from 0.244 to 0.151 while traditional results stay comparatively flat. In a low-SNR extension (15 dB per-frame bursts at 0.35 micron), a multi-frame Neural ISP recovers performance close to the bright-light single-frame baseline, whereas a multi-frame traditional ISP shows no meaningful improvement -- indicating that traditional pipelines at small pixels are bottlenecked by uncorrected PSF blur rather than by noise. These results point to a design philosophy in which Neural ISPs enable high-resolution telephoto modules by correcting residual optical aberrations rather than requiring increasingly complex optics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用学习型神经ISP替代传统ISP，通过建模并反转点扩散函数（PSF）来校正智能手机长焦相机中因像素尺寸缩小（亚0.5微米）导致的几何像差，从而突破“长焦物理墙”。实验表明，在0.35微米像素下，神经ISP的MTF50达到745 cycles/mm，相比传统ISP提升2.5-3倍，LPIPS从0.244降至0.151，且多帧神经ISP在低信噪比下仍能恢复接近亮光单帧的性能。
AI.motivation: 智能手机长焦相机面临“长焦物理墙”：像素间距缩小至亚0.5微米时，光学系统受几何像差限制，分辨率提升收益递减。传统ISP由于采用局部、分阶段处理，且没有底层点扩散函数（PSF）的显式模型，无法消除这些像差，因此需要一种能够建模并反转PSF的学习型ISP来突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 通过受控仿真模拟典型长焦模组，评估五种像素间距配置（0.35-0.75微米），保持光圈按比例缩放以固定每像素信噪比和衍射光斑尺寸，从而隔离几何像差和空间采样效应。对比传统ISP与基于学习的神经ISP（训练时使用底层退化模型），并在低信噪比场景下引入多帧神经ISP进行性能恢复。
AI.result: 1) 传统ISP随像素缩小改进有限，而神经ISP性能显著提升：0.35微米下MTF50达745 cycles/mm（垂直），分辨率提升2.5-3倍；LPIPS从0.244降至0.151，传统ISP则保持平稳。2) 低信噪比（15 dB每帧突发）下，多帧神经ISP性能接近亮光单帧基线，而多帧传统ISP无实质改进，表明小像素下传统流水线的瓶颈是未校正的PSF模糊而非噪声。
AI.conclusion: 神经ISP能够通过校正残余光学像差而非依赖日益复杂的光学系统，实现高分辨率长焦模组的设计。这指向一种新的设计哲学：利用学习型ISP将小像素设计转化为净优势，突破传统光学与信号处理的局限。
AI.abstract_zh: 智能手机长焦相机正逼近一道"长焦物理墙"：随着像素间距缩小至亚0.5微米，光学系统仍受几何像差限制，导致分辨率提升收益递减。传统的图像信号处理器（ISP）无法消除这些像差，因为它们通过局部的、分阶段的处理方式运行，缺乏对底层点扩散函数（PSF）的显式建模。我们展示了一种基于学习的神经ISP如何进行图像复原，通过训练学习底层退化模型，从而反转了分阶段流水线无法处理的问题，将小像素设计转化为净优势。我们通过对一个代表性长焦模组进行受控仿真来研究这一问题，评估了五种配置（0.35-0.75微米像素间距）。光圈按比例缩放以保持每像素信噪比和衍射光斑尺寸固定，从而隔离几何像差和空间采样效应。传统ISP随像素缩小改进有限，而神经ISP性能显著提升：在0.35微米下，其垂直MTF50达到745 cycles/mm，分辨率较传统ISP提升2.5-3倍，LPIPS从0.244显著改善至0.151，而传统ISP结果保持相对平稳。在低信噪比扩展实验（0.35微米下每帧突发15 dB）中，多帧神经ISP恢复的性能接近亮光单帧基线，而多帧传统ISP则无明显改善——这表明传统流水线在小像素下受限于未校正的PSF模糊而非噪声。这些结果指向一种设计理念：神经ISP通过校正残余光学像差而非要求日益复杂的光学系统，从而实现高分辨率长焦模组。

title: Page image classifier fine-tuned on century-spanning archives of scanned documents for further content-specific processing
comment: 29 pages, 19 figures, 13 tables. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2507.21114
summary: Purpose: Digitization projects in the humanities produce vast, heterogeneous archives of historical documents, making manual sorting impractical at scale. This work addresses the need for an automated system to classify scanned page images based on visual content type - text, tables, and graphics - enabling content-specific downstream processing such as Optical Character Recognition (OCR) or structured data extraction. Methods: An image classification system was developed and evaluated on a dataset of over 48,000 annotated historical page images from century-old Czech archaeological archives, refined through four successive annotation stages with domain-expert review. A Random Forest Classifier baseline was established using hand-crafted image features. Subsequently, deep learning architectures were fine-tuned and compared: Convolutional Neural Networks (EfficientNetV2, RegNetY), Vision and Document Image Transformers (ViT, DiT), and multimodal CLIP models. An 11-category label scheme was designed collaboratively with domain experts and evaluated via five-fold cross-validation. Results: The feature-based baseline achieved approximately 75% accuracy. Fine-tuned CNNs and Transformers substantially outperformed it, with RegNetY-16GF achieving 99.16% and ViT-large 99.12% Top-1 accuracy on the held-out test set. CLIP ViT-B/16 reached 99.14% with optimized text descriptions. Conclusion: Image-only models, particularly RegNetY-16GF, deliver near-perfect classification accuracy and produce consistent labels across 649,508 unlabeled archival pages with over 90% inter-model agreement. Fine-tuned CLIP, despite competitive test-set accuracy, showed under 65% agreement with image-only models on unlabeled data, making it less suitable for deployment. The final models, annotated dataset, and software are publicly available under open-source licenses.

AI.tldr: 本文针对人文学科数字化项目中历史文档图像的大规模自动分类需求，构建了包含48,000余张标注图像的捷克考古档案数据集，比较了传统特征工程、CNN、Transformer及多模态CLIP模型。RegNetY-16GF以99.16%的Top-1准确率实现近乎完美的分类，并在64.9万张未标注页面上展现出超过90%的模型间一致性，最终模型与数据集均以开源形式发布。
AI.motivation: 人文学科数字化项目产生海量异构历史档案，人工按视觉内容类型（文本、表格、图形）进行分类在大规模场景下不可行，亟需自动化分类系统以支持后续内容特定的下游处理（如OCR或结构化数据提取）。
AI.method: 构建了包含48,000余张标注历史页面图像的数据集，经四轮领域专家审核标注。以随机森林分类器（基于手工图像特征）作为基准，随后微调并比较了多种深度学习架构：CNN（EfficientNetV2, RegNetY）、视觉与文档图像Transformer（ViT, DiT）以及多模态CLIP模型。采用与领域专家共同设计的11类别标签方案，通过五折交叉验证进行评估。
AI.result: 基于特征的基线方法准确率约75%。微调后的CNN和Transformer显著超越基线：RegNetY-16GF达99.16%，ViT-large达99.12% Top-1准确率。CLIP ViT-B/16在优化文本描述后达99.14%。在649,508张未标注档案页面上，纯图像模型间一致性超过90%；但微调CLIP与纯图像模型的一致性低于65%，不适合部署。
AI.conclusion: 纯图像模型（尤其是RegNetY-16GF）能够实现近乎完美的分类准确率，并在大规模未标注数据上保持高度一致。微调CLIP尽管在测试集上表现优异，但在未标注数据上与纯图像模型的一致性差，不适宜实际部署。最终模型、标注数据集及软件均以开源形式发布。
AI.abstract_zh: 目的：人文学科的数字化项目产生了海量异构的历史档案文献，使得人工分类在大规模场景下不可行。本研究旨在解决基于视觉内容类型（文本、表格和图形）对扫描页面图像进行自动分类的需求，从而支持内容特定的下游处理，如光学字符识别（OCR）或结构化数据提取。方法：我们开发并评估了一个图像分类系统，数据集包含超过48,000张来自百年历史的捷克考古档案的标注历史页面图像，经过四轮连续的标注阶段并由领域专家审核。建立了基于手工图像特征的随机森林分类器作为基线。随后，微调并比较了多种深度学习架构：卷积神经网络（EfficientNetV2, RegNetY）、视觉和文档图像Transformer（ViT, DiT）以及多模态CLIP模型。与领域专家协作设计了11类别标签方案，并通过五折交叉验证进行评估。结果：基于特征的基线达到了约75%的准确率。微调后的CNN和Transformer显著优于基线，其中RegNetY-16GF在保留测试集上达到99.16%的Top-1准确率，ViT-large达到99.12%。CLIP ViT-B/16在优化文本描述后达到了99.14%的Top-1准确率。结论：纯图像模型，尤其是RegNetY-16GF，能够实现近乎完美的分类准确率，并在649,508张未标注档案页面上产生一致的标签，模型间一致性超过90%。微调后的CLIP尽管在测试集上表现具有竞争力，但在未标注数据上与纯图像模型的一致性低于65%，因此不适合部署。最终模型、标注数据集和软件均以开源许可协议公开发布。

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Plasma Control in Nuclear Fusion: Codebase and Benchmark
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising route for developing plasma controllers from historical tokamak data, since online trial-and-error on real devices is costly and risky. However, progress in this direction remains difficult to measure due to the lack of a standardized offline RL benchmark for realistic multi-actuator, long-horizon plasma control problems in nuclear fusion. We introduce RL4F, an Offline Reinforcement Learning Benchmark for Plasma Control in Nuclear Fusion, providing closed-loop evaluation environments and baseline comparisons across four full-profile tracking tasks: rotation, density, temperature, and pressure. The dynamics function underlying the evaluation environment is built from historical discharge data from DIII-D, a real-world Tokamak. We evaluate a broad set of imitation learning and offline RL baselines under a unified protocol. We find that offline model-based RL methods obtain the best average performance on most objectives, although no single method dominates all tasks, highlighting the importance of dynamics modeling in complex, long-horizon plasma control tasks. To foster further research, we open-source the codebase, datasets, and evaluation framework, providing a benchmark not only for the fusion community but also for algorithm development in offline RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RL4F，一个面向核聚变等离子体控制的离线强化学习基准，包含基于DIII-D托卡马克历史数据的闭环评估环境和多项基线比较。实验表明离线模型基RL方法在大多数任务上表现最优，但无单一方法在所有任务中占优。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习为从历史托卡马克数据开发等离子体控制器提供了可行途径，但缺乏标准化的离线RL基准来衡量这一方向的进展，尤其是针对核聚变中多执行器、长时域的实际等离子体控制问题。
AI.method: 构建了RL4F基准，其评估环境基于DIII-D托卡马克历史放电数据的动力学模型，涵盖旋转、密度、温度和压强四种等离子体剖面跟踪任务，并在统一协议下评估了多种模仿学习和离线RL基线方法。
AI.result: 离线模型基RL方法在大多数任务上取得了最佳平均性能，但没有任何单一方法在所有任务中占优，凸显了在复杂长时域等离子体控制任务中动力学建模的重要性。
AI.conclusion: RL4F为核聚变社区和离线RL算法开发提供了一个标准化基准，开源了代码、数据集和评估框架，有助于推动该领域的研究进展。
AI.abstract_zh: 离线强化学习为从历史托卡马克数据开发等离子体控制器提供了有前景的途径，因为在真实设备上进行在线试错代价高昂且存在风险。然而，由于缺乏针对核聚变中实际多执行器、长时域等离子体控制问题的标准化离线RL基准，这一方向的进展仍难以衡量。我们提出了RL4F——一个面向核聚变等离子体控制的离线强化学习基准，提供了闭环评估环境以及涵盖旋转、密度、温度和压强四种全剖面跟踪任务的基线对比。评估环境背后的动力学函数基于真实托卡马克DIII-D的历史放电数据构建。我们在统一协议下评估了广泛的模仿学习和离线RL基线方法。实验发现，离线模型基RL方法在大多数目标上取得了最佳平均性能，但没有任何单一方法在所有任务中占优，这凸显了动力学建模在复杂、长时域等离子体控制任务中的重要性。为促进进一步研究，我们开源了代码库、数据集和评估框架，为核聚变社区以及离线RL算法开发提供了一个基准平台。

title: This is how the Neocortex Learns
summary: A sufficient account of how the neocortex learns must meet three criteria: 1. Computationally, it must approximate a powerful, general-purpose learning algorithm known to scale to human-level intelligence; 2. Algorithmically, it must be implementable using known, well-established neural circuits within the neocortex and associated brain structures; 3. Implementationally, there must be a detailed account for how all of the algorithmic mechanisms actually function at a neurochemical level. At present, there is only one framework that meets all of these criteria: error-driven predictive learning via temporal derivatives, driven by corticothalamic circuits, based on competitive kinase synaptic plasticity induction mechanisms. This has been implemented in the Axon neural simulation framework using spiking neurons, and demonstrated to learn across a wide range of challenging cognitively motivated tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并论证了唯一满足新皮层学习三个必要条件的框架：基于时间导数的错误驱动预测学习，通过皮质-丘脑回路实现，并由竞争性激酶突触可塑性诱导机制支持。该框架已在Axon神经模拟框架中通过脉冲神经元实现，并在多种认知任务上证明了学习能力。
AI.motivation: 寻找一个能够同时满足计算、算法和实现三个层面必要条件的新皮层学习理论框架，弥补现有理论在这三个标准上的不足。
AI.method: 基于时间导数的错误驱动预测学习框架，采用皮质-丘脑回路实现算法机制，利用竞争性激酶突触可塑性诱导机制在神经化学层面实现，并在Axon神经模拟框架中使用脉冲神经元进行实现和验证。
AI.result: 该框架在Axon神经模拟框架中通过脉冲神经元实现，并在多种具有挑战性的认知任务上展示了学习能力。
AI.conclusion: 目前唯一能够同时满足新皮层学习三个必要条件的框架是基于时间导数的错误驱动预测学习，结合皮质-丘脑回路和竞争性激酶突触可塑性机制。
AI.abstract_zh: 要完整解释新皮层的学习机制，必须满足三个标准：1. 在计算层面，它必须近似于一种强大的、通用型学习算法，且该算法已被证明可扩展到人类水平的智能；2. 在算法层面，它必须能够利用新皮层及相关脑结构中已知的、已充分确立的神经回路来实现；3. 在实现层面，必须详细说明所有算法机制在神经化学水平上是如何实际运作的。目前，只有一个框架能够同时满足所有这些标准：基于时间导数的错误驱动预测学习，由皮质-丘脑回路驱动，并依托竞争性激酶突触可塑性诱导机制。该框架已在Axon神经模拟框架中通过脉冲神经元实现，并在多种具有挑战性的认知任务上证明了其学习能力。

title: CG-MambaNet: A spatiotemporal framework for cross-patient epileptic seizure prediction using CNN-GCN-Mamba-BiLSTM with event-level clinical evaluation
summary: Epileptic seizure prediction from scalp EEG is critical for closed-loop neurostimulation therapy. Existing deep-learning methods share two architectural limitations: they model EEG channels independently, neglecting inter-channel spatial synchrony, and process raw time-domain samples without frequency decomposition. A methodological limitation also affects the field: most studies use data splits that permit patient-level information leakage, yielding optimistic estimates that do not generalise to unseen patients. We present CG-MambaNet, a spatiotemporal seizure prediction framework addressing all three limitations. A depthwise separable CNN front-end decomposes each EEG patch into multi-scale spectro-temporal features, capturing delta-to-gamma band dynamics before sequence modelling. A two-layer graph convolutional network with a learnable adjacency matrix captures inter-channel functional synchrony without montage-specific coordinates, applicable to bipolar (CHB-MIT) and referential (SIENA) montages. A bidirectional Mamba encoder followed by a bidirectional LSTM models long- and short-range temporal dynamics, and a two-layer MLP produces the final seizure probability. This serial hierarchy ensures frequency decomposition precedes spatial mixing, which precedes temporal integration. Under strict leave-one-patient-out cross-validation with five independent random seeds, CG-MambaNet achieves AUC-ROC of 0.8152+/-0.0176 on CHB-MIT (n=22) and 0.7104+/-0.0261 on SIENA (n=6), surpassing all published cross-patient methods without domain adaptation. An event-level evaluation framework merging consecutive alarmed windows via a persistence filter reduces false predictions to 0.32 alarms/hour on CHB-MIT, demonstrating clinically meaningful alarm burden.

AI.tldr: 提出CG-MambaNet，一种针对头皮EEG癫痫发作预测的时空框架，通过可分离卷积提取多尺度频谱特征、图卷积网络建模通道间功能同步、双向Mamba与LSTM建模时序动态，在严格留一患者交叉验证下超越现有跨患者方法，并将误报率降至0.32次/小时。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法存在三个局限性：独立建模EEG通道而忽略通道间空间同步、直接在原始时域样本上处理未进行频率分解、多数研究采用的数据划分方式存在患者级信息泄露导致性能估计过于乐观且无法泛化到未见患者。
AI.method: CG-MambaNet包含三个串行模块：1）深度可分离CNN前端将每个EEG片段分解为多尺度频谱-时间特征，捕获delta到gamma波段动态；2）两层图卷积网络（GCN）配合可学习邻接矩阵捕获通道间功能同步，不依赖特定导联坐标，适用于双极和参考导联；3）双向Mamba编码器接双向LSTM建模长短时程时序动态，最后由两层MLP输出癫痫概率。
AI.result: 在严格留一患者交叉验证（5个独立随机种子）下，CHB-MIT数据集（n=22）上AUC-ROC达0.8152±0.0176，SIENA数据集（n=6）上达0.7104±0.0261，超越所有已发表的跨患者方法（无域自适应）。事件级评估中，通过持续滤波器合并连续告警窗口，CHB-MIT上误报率降至0.32次/小时。
AI.conclusion: CG-MambaNet通过频率分解先于空间混合、空间混合先于时间整合的串行层次结构，有效解决了现有方法的三大局限，在跨患者泛化上取得显著优势，且临床告警负担可控。
AI.abstract_zh: 从头皮脑电图（EEG）进行癫痫发作预测对于闭环神经刺激治疗至关重要。现有的深度学习方法存在两个架构局限：它们独立建模EEG通道，忽略了通道间的空间同步性，并且在处理原始时域样本时未进行频率分解。该领域还存在一个方法论局限：大多数研究采用的数据划分方式允许患者级信息泄露，从而产生过于乐观的估计，无法泛化到未见患者。我们提出CG-MambaNet，一个解决上述三个局限的时空癫痫发作预测框架。其深度可分离卷积神经网络前端将每个EEG片段分解为多尺度频谱-时间特征，在序列建模之前捕获从delta到gamma频带的动态。一个具有可学习邻接矩阵的双层图卷积网络捕获通道间的功能同步性，无需特定导联坐标，适用于双极导联（CHB-MIT）和参考导联（SIENA）。双向Mamba编码器后接双向长短期记忆网络建模长程和短程时序动态，双层多层感知机输出最终癫痫概率。这一串行层次结构确保频率分解先于空间混合，空间混合先于时间整合。在严格的留一患者交叉验证及五个独立随机种子下，CG-MambaNet在CHB-MIT数据集（n=22）上达到AUC-ROC为0.8152±0.0176，在SIENA数据集（n=6）上达到0.7104±0.0261，超越了所有已发表的跨患者方法且无需域自适应。通过持续滤波器合并连续告警窗口的事件级评估框架将错误预测降至CHB-MIT上0.32次告警/小时，展示了临床意义上的告警负担。

title: Multi-planar 2D-U-Net Segmentation of 3D-CT Abdominal Organs augmented by Spatial Occurrence Maps
summary: This work proposes a lightweight 2D-U-Net-based framework for segmenting five abdominal organs in large field-of-view 3D CT scans. The method combines coarse-to-fine segmentation, predictions from multiple anatomical planes, and additional fuzzy 3D spatial maps that provide anatomical location cues to improve segmentation accuracy. We combine multi-planar 2D-U-Net models augmented by a spatial occurrence map. The approach involves two main stages. First, the abdominal volume of interest region is detected by traversing the whole scan axially with a 2D-U-Net and determining the x-y-z-minimum and -maximum extents of the 5 abdominal organs of interest. Second, we use spatial occurrence maps to enhance our multi-planar 2D-U-net architecture inside the bounds from the former stage. The method is evaluated on 80 CT scans from various public sources. The results show Dice improvements of about 4% at maximum compared to the same model trained without spatial occurrence maps.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于轻量级2D-U-Net的框架，结合多平面预测与模糊3D空间地图，用于在3D CT扫描中分割五个腹部器官，相比基线模型Dice最高提升约4%。
AI.motivation: 在大视野3D CT扫描中分割腹部器官面临计算成本高、器官边界模糊等挑战，现有方法难以兼顾效率与精度，因此需要一种轻量级且能利用空间位置信息的有效分割框架。
AI.method: 方法分两阶段：第一阶段，用2D-U-Net沿轴向遍历整个扫描，检测腹部体积感兴趣区域，确定五个器官的x-y-z最小/最大范围；第二阶段，在边界内使用多平面2D-U-Net架构，并引入模糊3D空间发生图（spatial occurrence maps）提供解剖位置线索以增强分割精度。
AI.result: 在来自多个公开来源的80个CT扫描上评估，与未使用空间发生图的相同模型相比，Dice系数最高提升约4%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的结合多平面2D-U-Net与模糊3D空间发生图的轻量级框架能有效提升腹部器官分割精度，验证了空间位置线索在粗到细分割策略中的价值。
AI.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于轻量级2D-U-Net的框架，用于在大视野3D CT扫描中分割五个腹部器官。该方法结合了粗到细分割、多个解剖平面的预测以及额外的模糊3D空间图（spatial maps），后者提供解剖位置线索以提升分割精度。我们将多平面2D-U-Net模型与空间发生图（spatial occurrence map）相结合。该方法包含两个主要阶段。首先，通过沿轴向用2D-U-Net遍历整个扫描，确定五个目标腹部器官的x-y-z最小和最大范围，从而检测腹部体积感兴趣区域。其次，在前一阶段确定的边界内，使用空间发生图增强我们的多平面2D-U-Net架构。该方法在来自多个公开来源的80个CT扫描上进行了评估。结果表明，与未使用空间发生图训练的相同模型相比，Dice系数最高提升约4%。

title: Multimodal Group Emotion Recognition In-the-Wild Towards a Privacy-Safe Non-Individual Approach
summary: This thesis addresses group emotion recognition (GER) in-the-wild with a focus on privacy preservation. Unlike traditional emotion recognition methods that rely on individual-level cues such as face, gaze, or voice analysis, this work uses collective audio-video signals to infer emotions at the group level, reducing risks of individual monitoring and surveillance. Two complementary frameworks are proposed. The first is a cross-attention multimodal architecture for audio-video fusion, combined with Frames Attention Pooling (FAP) for temporal aggregation. It is supported by synthetic data augmentation and validated through ablation studies, demonstrating robustness in real-world GER conditions. The second framework, Variational Encoder Multi-Decoder (VE-MD), learns a shared latent space for emotion classification and structural representation prediction, including body and face cues. Two decoding strategies, DETR-based and heatmap-based, are explored to analyze the role of structural representations in group and individual settings. The thesis makes three main contributions: it clarifies the role of multimodality and structural cues in group-level affective computing; introduces two architectures for privacy-preserving multimodal GER; and shows that competitive performance can be achieved without using individual features as input data.

AI.tldr: 本文针对野外群体情绪识别（GER）中的隐私保护问题，提出了两种互补框架：跨注意力多模态音频-视频融合架构（结合帧注意力池化）和变分编码器多解码器（VE-MD）架构。实验表明，在不使用个体特征作为输入的情况下，仍能达到有竞争力的性能，同时有效降低个体监控风险。
AI.motivation: 传统的情绪识别方法依赖个体级线索（如面部、视线或语音分析），存在个体监控和监视的风险。本文旨在通过利用集体音频-视频信号在群体层面推断情绪，从而在保护隐私的前提下实现有效的群体情绪识别。
AI.method: 提出两种互补框架：(1) 跨注意力多模态音频-视频融合架构，结合帧注意力池化（FAP）进行时间聚合，并采用合成数据增强；(2) 变分编码器多解码器（VE-MD）架构，学习用于情绪分类和结构表征预测（包括身体和面部线索）的共享潜在空间，探索了基于DETR和基于热图的两种解码策略。
AI.result: 通过消融研究验证了方法的鲁棒性；两种解码策略分别分析了结构表征在群体和个体设置中的作用；实验表明在不使用个体特征作为输入数据的情况下仍能达到有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 三个主要贡献：(1) 阐明了多模态和结构线索在群体级情感计算中的作用；(2) 提出了两种用于隐私保护的多模态群体情绪识别架构；(3) 证明了无需个体特征作为输入即可实现有竞争力的性能。
AI.abstract_zh: 本论文针对野外场景下的群体情绪识别（GER）问题，重点关注隐私保护。与依赖个体级线索（如面部、视线或语音分析）的传统情绪识别方法不同，本文利用集体音频-视频信号在群体层面推断情绪，从而降低个体监控和监视的风险。本文提出了两种互补框架。第一种是用于音频-视频融合的跨注意力多模态架构，结合帧注意力池化（FAP）进行时间聚合。该架构得到合成数据增强的支持，并通过消融研究验证，在真实世界群体情绪识别条件下展现出鲁棒性。第二种框架——变分编码器多解码器（VE-MD）——学习一个共享潜在空间，用于情绪分类和结构表征预测（包括身体和面部线索）。本文探索了基于DETR和基于热图的两种解码策略，以分析结构表征在群体和个体设置中的作用。本论文的三大贡献包括：阐明了多模态和结构线索在群体级情感计算中的作用；提出了两种用于隐私保护的多模态群体情绪识别架构；证明了在不使用个体特征作为输入数据的情况下，仍能达到有竞争力的性能。

title: MedicalRec: Medical recommender system for image classification without retraining
summary: The emergence of machine learning and deep learning has revolutionized the efficiency of diagnostic, therapeutic, and administrative systems in healthcare. However, this rapid adoption has come at the cost of requiring significant computing power and energy consumption, as well as e-waste disposal and carbon emissions. One of the challenges of these models is choosing the right model for classification tasks. To this end, researchers attempt to identify the optimal model using their data through trial and error, which involves energy consumption and waste. The goal of this study is to develop a model-based recommender system for medical image classification. For this purpose, a data set was collected from 3,000 articles in the field of medical image classification. This dataset, publicly available under the name MedicalRec-Bench, contains over 5,000 records of models tested in various tasks, including Skin Cancer Classification, Tumour Classification, Wound Classification, Breast Cancer, and MRI classification. The dataset was evaluated in four different modes, depending on the number of features: MedicalRec I (5 features), MedicalRec II (9 features), MedicalRec III (11 features), and MedicalRec IV (18 features). Collecting all values for the features is challenging due to non-reporting by the authors; hence, the dataset contains significant amounts of missing values. The Medical Recommender System (MedicalRec) is a transformer-based model used for item recommendations in this study. This model achieved remarkable results in the evaluation on the dataset and in the evaluation with 12 base models. This model achieved a maximum HitRate@100 of 75.5%. The dataset and implementations are available through the GitHub link: https://github.com/Ramin1Mousa/MedicalRec

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于Transformer的医学图像分类模型推荐系统（MedicalRec），并构建了包含5000多条记录的数据集MedicalRec-Bench，在多种配置下最高HitRate@100达75.5%，旨在帮助研究者减少试错带来的能耗与浪费。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习/深度学习模型在医学图像分类任务中面临模型选择困难，研究者往往通过反复试错来寻找最优模型，这个过程消耗大量计算资源和能源，并产生电子垃圾和碳排放。因此需要一种推荐系统来高效地为特定任务推荐合适的分类模型。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含从3000篇医学图像分类论文中提取的5000多条记录的数据集MedicalRec-Bench，涵盖皮肤癌、肿瘤、伤口、乳腺癌和MRI等分类任务。数据集按特征数量分为四种模式（5/9/11/18个特征）。在此基础上，提出了一个基于Transformer架构的推荐模型MedicalRec，用于为给定任务推荐最优模型。
AI.result: 在MedicalRec-Bench数据集上的评估中，MedicalRec模型在12个基模型对比中表现优异，最高HitRate@100达到75.5%。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer的MedicalRec推荐系统能够有效地为医学图像分类任务推荐合适的模型，减少盲目试错带来的能源消耗和资源浪费。
AI.abstract_zh: 机器学习和深度学习的出现彻底改变了医疗保健中诊断、治疗和行政系统的效率。然而，这种快速普及是以消耗大量计算能力和能源、以及产生电子垃圾和碳排放为代价的。这些模型面临的挑战之一是如何为分类任务选择合适的模型。为此，研究者们试图通过反复试错的方式利用他们的数据来识别最优模型，这一过程涉及能源消耗和浪费。本研究的目标是开发一个基于模型的医学图像分类推荐系统。为此，我们从3000篇医学图像分类领域的论文中收集了一个数据集。该数据集以MedicalRec-Bench的名称公开，包含超过5000条记录，涉及多种任务中测试的模型，包括皮肤癌分类、肿瘤分类、伤口分类、乳腺癌分类和MRI分类。根据特征数量的不同，该数据集在四种模式下进行了评估：MedicalRec I（5个特征）、MedicalRec II（9个特征）、MedicalRec III（11个特征）和MedicalRec IV（18个特征）。由于作者未报告相关信息，收集所有特征值具有挑战性，因此该数据集中包含大量缺失值。Medical Recommender System（MedicalRec）是一个基于Transformer的模型，在本研究中用于项目推荐。该模型在数据集评估以及与12个基模型的对比评估中取得了显著结果，最高HitRate@100达到75.5%。该数据集和实现代码可通过GitHub链接获取：https://github.com/Ramin1Mousa/MedicalRec

title: Discovering Functionally Selective Brain Regions with a Deep Topographic Multimodal Model
comment: Preprint. First two author contributed equally
summary: Nearby neurons in cortex share similar response profiles, producing systematic spatial organization across sensory and cognitive systems. Recent topographic models reproduce aspects of this structure but remain unimodal and spatially constrain each layer separately, yielding fragmented maps that capture neither the contiguity of cortical processing streams nor their integration across modalities. We introduce Topo-Omni, a topographic multimodal model in which visual, auditory, and language/cognitive processing share a single contiguous in-silico sheet. Built by fine-tuning a pretrained foundation model with a spatial smoothness objective, this architecture develops clusters across modalities that are consistent with human neuroimaging, from sensory to cognitive systems. Driving or suppressing a cluster selectively biases or impairs perception, paralleling human intervention studies. Finally, we use our model to screen for novel clusters in-silico and discover new natural landscape and animal networks which we validate in human data. A single spatial principle thus organizes representations across modalities and processing stages, yielding testable hypotheses about cortical organization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Topo-Omni，一种拓扑多模态模型，通过单一连续的皮层板统一视觉、听觉和语言处理，复现了从感觉到认知系统的空间组织，并可用于发现新的皮层网络。
AI.motivation: 现有拓扑模型仅模拟单模态、且每层独立施加空间约束，产生碎片化图谱，无法体现皮层处理流的连续性和跨模态整合，亟需一个统一的多模态空间组织模型。
AI.method: 在预训练基础模型上微调，引入空间平滑性目标函数，使视觉、听觉和语言/认知处理共享一个连续的in-silico皮层板，形成跨模态的聚类结构。
AI.result: 模型产生的跨模态聚类与人脑神经影像一致；选择性驱动或抑制某聚类可偏向或损害对应感知，类似人类干预研究；利用模型在硅内筛选发现了新的自然景观和动物网络，并在人类数据中验证。
AI.conclusion: 单一的空间组织原则可以统一不同模态和处理阶段的大脑表征，为皮层组织提供可检验的假设。
AI.abstract_zh: 大脑皮层中相邻的神经元具有相似的反应特征，从而在感觉和认知系统中产生系统的空间组织。最近的拓扑模型再现了这种结构的某些方面，但它们仍然是单模态的，并且对每一层分别施加空间约束，产生碎片化的图谱，既无法捕捉皮层处理流的连续性，也无法捕捉跨模态的整合。我们提出了Topo-Omni，一种拓扑多模态模型，其中视觉、听觉和语言/认知处理共享一个单一的连续体外计算皮层板。通过使用空间平滑性目标微调预训练基础模型，该架构形成了与人类神经影像一致的跨模态聚类，覆盖从感觉到认知系统。选择性驱动或抑制某个聚类会有偏向地调节或损害相应的感知，这与人类干预研究相似。最后，我们利用该模型在硅内筛选新的聚类，发现了新的自然景观和动物网络，并在人类数据中进行了验证。因此，单一的空间原则可组织跨模态和处理阶段的表征，为皮层组织提供可检验的假设。

title: A dual-system approach for epilepsy diagnosis: integrating mamba-Bi-LSTM architecture with SHAP-based verification
summary: This study develops a medical AI-assisted diagnosis system based on deep learning, which provides intelligent diagnostic solutions for epilepsy, a disease that seriously threatens the life and health of patients. Epilepsy has sudden and unpredictable seizures. Traditional diagnostic methods mainly rely on doctors' manual interpretation of EEG, which is time-consuming and dependent by experience. In response to the above challenges, this study designed a dual-system intelligent diagnosis framework, which includes two core components: the main discrimination system and the verification system. The main discrimination system uses a deep learning model that combines the innovative Mamba architecture with the Bi-LSTM structure to integrate and analyze heterogeneous data to achieve extremely high diagnostic accuracy; the verification system provides an explainable diagnostic basis through the SHAP method to enhance the credibility of the results. This system establishes a cross-modal database to realize intelligent analysis of multi-source heterogeneous data-fusion EEG signals and clinical text data for epilepsy. The system outputs results based on diagnostic consistency and confidence levels, and high-confidence predictions can also be used as automatic feedback sources to optimize the model. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the main discriminant model of the intelligent diagnosis system for epilepsy has increased from 92.6% to 98.7% and the F1 score has increased from 0.895 to 0.992, all of which have exceeded the existing optimal methods; the average processing time for verification system feedback integration is only 220 ms, which increases the overall diagnostic accuracy by 5.1%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的医疗AI辅助诊断系统，采用Mamba架构与Bi-LSTM结合的主判别系统及SHAP验证系统，用于癫痫智能诊断。实验表明，系统准确率从92.6%提升至98.7%，F1分数从0.895提升至0.992，验证系统平均处理时间仅220ms，整体诊断准确率提升5.1%。
AI.motivation: 癫痫发作具有突发性和不可预测性，传统诊断方法依赖医生人工判读脑电图，耗时且依赖经验。为此，本研究旨在开发一种基于深度学习的医疗AI辅助诊断系统，以提升癫痫诊断的准确性和效率，并增强诊断结果的可解释性。
AI.method: 设计了一个双系统智能诊断框架：(1) 主判别系统采用融合Mamba架构与Bi-LSTM结构的深度学习模型，对多源异构数据（脑电图信号与临床文本数据）进行集成分析；(2) 验证系统通过SHAP方法提供可解释的诊断依据。系统建立跨模态数据库，基于诊断一致性和置信度水平输出结果，高置信度预测可作为自动反馈源优化模型。
AI.result: 主判别模型准确率从92.6%提升至98.7%，F1分数从0.895提升至0.992，均超过现有最优方法；验证系统反馈集成的平均处理时间仅为220ms，整体诊断准确率提升5.1%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的双系统智能诊断框架在癫痫诊断中取得了显著优于现有方法的性能，验证系统在极短处理时间内有效提升了诊断准确率，验证了该框架在临床辅助诊断中的可行性与优越性。
AI.abstract_zh: 本研究开发了一种基于深度学习的医疗AI辅助诊断系统，为严重威胁患者生命健康的癫痫疾病提供智能诊断方案。癫痫发作具有突发性和不可预测性，传统诊断方法主要依赖医生人工判读脑电图，耗时且依赖经验。针对上述挑战，本研究设计了一个双系统智能诊断框架，包含两个核心组件：主判别系统和验证系统。主判别系统采用融合创新Mamba架构与Bi-LSTM结构的深度学习模型，对异构数据进行集成分析，以实现极高的诊断准确率；验证系统通过SHAP方法提供可解释的诊断依据，增强结果的可信度。本系统建立了跨模态数据库，实现对多源异构数据——融合脑电图信号与临床文本数据——的智能分析，用于癫痫诊断。系统基于诊断一致性和置信度水平输出结果，高置信度预测还可作为自动反馈源以优化模型。实验结果表明，智能诊断系统的主判别模型在癫痫诊断中的准确率从92.6%提升至98.7%，F1分数从0.895提升至0.992，均超过了现有最优方法；验证系统反馈集成的平均处理时间仅为220毫秒，使整体诊断准确率提升了5.1%。

title: Programmable Silicon Retina on Pixel Processor Array
summary: Standard dynamic vision sensors approximate retinal processing by detecting temporal contrast changes, offering high speed and high dynamic range. In this work, we explore whether incorporating additional biologically inspired processing stages - specifically spatial filtering and gain control - can offer advantages for certain downstream tasks such as saliency prediction. We present the first implementation of a multi-stage Silicon Retina model on the SCAMP-5 Pixel Processor Array, along with a GPU-based simulation framework. We evaluate the performance of our model on Video Intensity Reconstruction and Video Saliency Prediction. While the bio-inspired model is less effective at reconstructing absolute intensity frames, it achieves a 13\% reduction in saliency prediction loss in comparison to standard DVS event representation, while reducing the event rate by approximately 47\%. These experiments are obtained using a lightweight $\approx 100$k-parameter FireNet-style network, adapted from event-based reconstruction to saliency prediction. These results suggest that the silicon retina's "information distillation" mechanism can achieve a more efficient representation for downstream neural networks, particularly in bandwidth-constrained edge applications.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在 SCAMP-5 像素处理器阵列上实现了多阶段硅视网膜模型，并构建了 GPU 仿真框架。实验表明，该生物启发模型在视频显著预测任务上相比标准 DVS 事件表示降低了 13% 的损失，同时减少了约 47% 的事件率，尽管在绝对强度帧重建上效果较差，但展现了更高效的信息蒸馏能力。
AI.motivation: 探索在标准动态视觉传感器（DVS）基础上，额外融入生物启发的空间滤波和增益控制等处理阶段，能否为显著预测等下游任务带来性能优势。
AI.method: 在 SCAMP-5 像素处理器阵列上首次实现了多阶段硅视网膜模型，并构建了 GPU 仿真框架。采用轻量级约 10 万参数的 FireNet 风格网络，将基于事件的重建任务改造为显著预测任务，评估模型在视频强度重建和视频显著预测上的表现。
AI.result: 生物启发模型在绝对强度帧重建上效果较差；但在显著预测任务上相比标准 DVS 事件表示降低了 13% 的损失，同时事件率减少了约 47%。
AI.conclusion: 硅视网膜的"信息蒸馏"机制能够为下游神经网络提供更高效的事件表示，特别适用于带宽受限的边缘计算场景。
AI.abstract_zh: 标准动态视觉传感器通过检测时域对比度变化来近似视网膜处理，具有高速度和高动态范围的优势。在这项工作中，我们探索了引入额外的生物启发处理阶段——特别是空间滤波和增益控制——是否能为显著预测等下游任务带来优势。我们首次在 SCAMP-5 像素处理器阵列上实现了多阶段硅视网膜模型，并构建了基于 GPU 的仿真框架。我们在视频强度重建和视频显著预测任务上评估了模型性能。虽然生物启发模型在重建绝对强度帧方面效果较差，但与标准 DVS 事件表示相比，它在显著预测损失上降低了 13%，同时事件率减少了约 47%。这些实验采用了一个轻量级的约 10 万参数的 FireNet 风格网络，该网络从基于事件的重建任务改编而来用于显著预测。这些结果表明，硅视网膜的"信息蒸馏"机制能够为下游神经网络提供更高效的表征，特别适用于带宽受限的边缘应用场景。

title: SlideCheck: Guiding Self-Supervised Pretraining of Pathology Foundation Models via Dataset Distributions
summary: Pathology foundation models are pretrained on large streams of WSI-derived patches, while supervision during data construction is often slide-level, sparse, or heterogeneous. This mismatch makes it difficult to understand and control which biological patterns enter the pretraining data. We propose SlideCheck, a lightweight pretraining data guidance tool built on frozen pathology foundation model patch features. Rather than serving as a standalone patch diagnostic model, SlideCheck provides explicit abnormality and malignancy scores for organizing, filtering, and auditing pathology pretraining data. SlideCheck uses a dual-head MLP to separately model broad abnormal morphology and malignant evidence. A regularized feature-space scorer provides a supervised anchor for patch-level evidence estimation, while score-attention agreement combines patch scores with WSI-level MIL attention to mine high-confidence pseudo labels. The same scores are then used to construct broad-positive ViT pretraining subsets, where a patch is selected if either abnormality or malignancy evidence exceeds a threshold. Experiments show that SlideCheck-defined data distributions influence the downstream behavior of self-supervised ViT pretraining, indicating that biological composition is an important controllable factor in pathology foundation model development. Curated subsets can approach full-data performance, suggesting that explicitly scored patch pools may support more efficient and auditable pretraining data construction. These findings position SlideCheck as a data guidance and auditing layer for transforming large, undifferentiated patch pools into controllable and reusable pretraining datasets.

AI.tldr: SlideCheck是一种轻量级预训练数据指导工具，基于冻结的病理基础模型patch特征，通过双头MLP分别建模异常形态和恶性证据，利用评分-注意力一致性和正则化特征空间评分器生成patch级异常/恶性分数，用于组织、过滤和审计病理预训练数据。实验表明，SlideCheck定义的数据分布能影响自监督ViT预训练的下游行为，筛选子集可接近全数据性能。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型通常在大量WSI patch上预训练，但数据构建时的监督信号往往是切片级别的、稀疏的或异质的，导致难以理解和控制哪些生物模式进入预训练数据。现有方法缺少一个轻量级的工具来对预训练数据进行组织和审计。
AI.method: SlideCheck使用双头MLP分别建模广泛的异常形态和恶性证据：(1) 正则化特征空间评分器为patch级证据估计提供监督锚点；(2) 评分-注意力一致性机制将patch分数与WSI级MIL注意力结合，挖掘高置信度伪标签。随后利用这些分数构建广泛正样本的ViT预训练子集，当异常或恶性证据超过阈值时选择该patch。
AI.result: 实验表明，SlideCheck定义的数据分布能够影响自监督ViT预训练的下游行为，说明生物组成是病理基础模型开发中重要的可控因素。筛选后的子集可以接近全数据训练的性能，表明显式评分的patch池可以支持更高效、可审计的预训练数据构建。
AI.conclusion: SlideCheck定位为一种数据指导和审计层，能够将大量无差别的patch池转化为可控且可复用的预训练数据集，为病理基础模型的数据构建提供了更高效、可审计的解决方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 病理基础模型在大量来自全切片图像（WSI）的补丁（patch）流上进行预训练，而数据构建过程中的监督信号通常是切片级别的、稀疏的或异质的。这种不匹配使得理解和控制哪些生物模式进入预训练数据变得困难。我们提出SlideCheck，一种轻量级的预训练数据指导工具，它建立在冻结的病理基础模型补丁特征之上。SlideCheck并非作为一个独立的补丁诊断模型，而是提供明确的异常评分和恶性评分，用于组织、筛选和审计病理预训练数据。SlideCheck使用双头多层感知机（MLP）分别建模广泛的异常形态和恶性证据。一个正则化的特征空间评分器为补丁级别的证据估计提供监督锚点，同时评分-注意力一致性机制将补丁分数与全切片图像级别的多实例学习（MIL）注意力相结合，以挖掘高置信度的伪标签。随后，相同的分数被用于构建广泛正样本的ViT预训练子集，其中当异常或恶性证据超过阈值时，选择该补丁。实验表明，SlideCheck定义的数据分布会影响自监督ViT预训练的下游行为，表明生物组成是病理基础模型开发中一个重要的可控因素。筛选后的子集可以接近全数据训练的性能，这表明显式评分的补丁池可以支持更高效、可审计的预训练数据构建。这些发现将SlideCheck定位为一种数据指导和审计层，用于将大量无差别的补丁池转化为可控且可复用的预训练数据集。

title: SPIN: Decentralized Swarm Control via Tensorized Policy Coordination
summary: Decentralized multi-agent swarm coordination on resource-constrained edge platforms remains fundamentally bottlenecked by the exponential scaling of joint action spaces and high-latency communication overhead. This paper introduces the Swarm Policy Interference Network (SPIN) framework, an architectural paradigm that bypasses these limitations by modeling swarm topologies as a compressed tensor network. We factorize the joint policy tensors of local multi-agent cliques into Matrix Product State (MPS) chains, reducing the computational complexity of evaluation from an exponential $O(n^m)$ wall to a strictly linear $O(m \cdot n \cdot χ^2)$ constraint. To bridge local continuous spatial geometry with this discrete algebraic backend without requiring power-intensive online training loops, we introduce a decoupled, hybrid neuro-symbolic control pipeline. Local multi-layered neural networks operate as structural coordination encoders, pre-trained offline to nonlinearly map hand-engineered geometric descriptors into abstract environmental target measures. At runtime, edge agents execute instantaneous behavioral adaptations by applying the Radon-Nikodým derivative directly as a zero-shot importance-reweighting filter. We validate the framework within a discrete-time multi-agent simulation sandbox spanning tracking, decentralized dispersion/area coverage, and multi-goal coordination regimes. Qualitative telemetry demonstrates that the integrated pipeline achieves stable target-directed motion, anti-collapse spatial spreading under decentralized constraints, and structured subgroup formation across multiple targets, providing a mathematically grounded route to tractable, low-power edge swarm intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPIN框架，通过张量网络压缩和混合神经符号控制，解决边缘平台上多智能体群协同的计算与通信瓶颈，实现线性复杂度推理与低功耗运行。
AI.motivation: 传统多智能体群协同在资源受限的边缘平台上面临两个根本瓶颈：联合动作空间呈指数爆炸，以及高延迟通信开销。现有方法难以在低功耗边缘设备上实现实时可扩展的协同控制。
AI.method: 1) 将群拓扑建模为压缩张量网络，利用矩阵乘积态(MPS)链分解局部多智能体团的联合策略张量，将评估复杂度从指数级O(n^m)降至线性级O(m·n·χ²)。2) 引入解耦的混合神经符号控制管道：离线预训练的局部神经网络将手工几何描述子映射为环境目标度量；运行时边缘代理通过Radon-Nikodým导数作为零样本重要性重加权滤波器，实现瞬时行为适应。
AI.result: 在离散时间多智能体仿真沙箱中，针对跟踪、分散覆盖和多目标协调三个任务进行验证。定性遥测表明：管道实现稳定的目标导向运动、分散约束下的抗塌缩空间扩展，以及多目标下的结构化子群形成。
AI.conclusion: SPIN提供了一条数学上有依据的路径，实现了在低功耗边缘设备上可计算、可扩展的群智能协同。
AI.abstract_zh: 在资源受限的边缘平台上，去中心化多智能体群协同面临着联合动作空间指数级扩张和高延迟通信开销的根本瓶颈。本文提出群策略干扰网络(SPIN)框架，这是一种通过将群拓扑建模为压缩张量网络来绕过这些限制的架构范式。我们将局部多智能体团的联合策略张量分解为矩阵乘积态(MPS)链，将评估的计算复杂度从指数级O(n^m)墙降低到严格的线性级O(m·n·χ²)约束。为桥接局部连续空间几何与此离散代数后端之间的鸿沟，且无需高功耗的在线训练循环，我们引入了一种解耦的混合神经符号控制管道。局部多层神经网络作为结构协调编码器，通过离线预训练将手工设计的几何描述子非线性映射为抽象的环境目标度量。在运行时，边缘代理通过直接应用Radon-Nikodým导数作为零样本重要性重加权滤波器，执行瞬时行为适应。我们在一个离散时间多智能体仿真沙箱中验证了该框架，涵盖跟踪、去中心化分散/区域覆盖以及多目标协调等场景。定性遥测表明，该集成管道实现了稳定的目标导向运动、去中心化约束下的抗塌缩空间扩展，以及跨多个目标的结构化子群形成，为在低功耗边缘设备上实现可计算的群智能提供了一条数学上有依据的路径。

title: Simultaneous hyperkinetic movement disorders phenotyping: a cross-cohort pediatric transfer study using routine videos, markerless pose estimation and a tabular foundation model
summary: Objective: To develop and externally test a video-based framework for simultaneous detection of hyperkinetic MDs phenomenologies: dystonia, tremor, myoclonus, chorea, athetosis, ballismus, stereotypies, and tics using routine clinical recordings, with explicit testing of external, cross-cohort transfer from adult to pediatric populations. Methods: In this proof-of-concept study, the framework combines markerless pose estimation, kinematic descriptors, and a pretrained fondation model. A shared predictive backbone was developed on 21 adults with confirmed hyperkinetic MDs and 4 healthy controls assessed under a standardized protocol. External validation was performed on an independent external cohort: a real-world pediatric sample (n=12, monogenic combined MDs). For the external dataset, the backbone was deployed without retraining; lightweight calibration adjusted only the final subject-level decision step using a small labeled subset of patients selected by clinicians as representative of the cohort's phenotypic range. Results: After local calibration of the decision layer on the clinician-selected subset, performance improved consistently on the held-out pediatric patients (n=7): Hamming accuracy rose from 0.804 to 0.839 and the Jaccard index from 0.548 to 0.633. This calibrated performance was preserved, and the Jaccard index further improved, when the evaluation was restricted to the phenomenologies with more definite clinician agreement (Hamming accuracy 0.9, Jaccard index 0.786), indicating that the gains did not rest on the least-reliable labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并外部验证了一个基于视频的框架，利用常规临床记录同时检测多种过度运动障碍（如肌张力障碍、震颤、肌阵挛、舞蹈症、手足徐动症、投掷症、刻板行为和抽动症）。该框架结合无标记姿态估计、运动学描述符和预训练基础模型，在成人队列上训练后，通过轻量级校准迁移至儿科真实世界样本，显著提升了分类性能（Jaccard指数从0.548升至0.633）。
AI.motivation: 过度运动障碍（HDs）的多种现象学（如肌张力障碍、震颤等）常同时出现，临床鉴别困难。现有方法多针对单一运动障碍，缺乏能同时检测多种现象学且可跨人群（成人到儿童）迁移的视频框架。
AI.method: 1) 使用无标记姿态估计提取患者运动关键点；2) 计算运动学描述符；3) 结合预训练基础模型构建共享预测主干；4) 在21名成人患者和4名健康对照上训练；5) 外部验证于12名儿科患者，不重新训练主干，仅通过临床医生选择的小样本进行轻量级校准（仅调整最终受试者级决策步骤）。
AI.result: 在保留的儿科患者（n=7）上：Hamming准确率从0.804提升至0.839，Jaccard指数从0.548提升至0.633。在临床医生诊断一致性更高的现象学子集上，Hamming准确率达0.9，Jaccard指数达0.786，表明性能提升不依赖于最不可靠的标签。
AI.conclusion: 该视频框架能够利用常规临床记录同时检测多种过度运动障碍现象学，并成功实现从成人队列到儿科人群的跨队列迁移，通过轻量级校准即可获得显著性能提升，具有良好的临床实用性和泛化能力。
AI.abstract_zh: 目的：开发并外部测试一个基于视频的框架，用于利用常规临床记录同时检测过度运动障碍（HDs）的多种现象学：肌张力障碍、震颤、肌阵挛、舞蹈症、手足徐动症、投掷症、刻板行为和抽动症，并明确测试从成人到儿科人群的外部跨队列迁移能力。方法：在这项概念验证研究中，该框架结合了无标记姿态估计、运动学描述符和预训练基础模型。在21名确诊的过度运动障碍成人患者和4名健康对照者的标准化评估方案数据上开发了共享预测主干。外部验证在一个独立的真实世界儿科队列（n=12，单基因复合型运动障碍）上进行。对于外部数据集，主干未经重新训练直接部署；轻量级校准仅调整了最终的受试者级决策步骤，使用临床医生选择的小标记子集（代表队列表型范围）。结果：在临床医生选择的子集上进行决策层局部校准后，保留的儿科患者（n=7）性能持续改善：Hamming准确率从0.804提升至0.839，Jaccard指数从0.548提升至0.633。当评估限定于临床医生诊断一致性更高的现象学时，校准后的性能得以保持且Jaccard指数进一步改善（Hamming准确率0.9，Jaccard指数0.786），表明性能提升不依赖于最不可靠的标签。

title: Spatio-Sequential Recurrent Network for 3-D Tunnel Propagation Modeling
summary: Fine-mesh parabolic wave equation (PWE) simulations are high-fidelity but time-consuming, which limits real-time tunnel propagation analysis and motivates coarse-to-fine reconstruction. Existing machine learning (ML)-assisted tunnel models typically provide only one-dimensional (1-D) longitudinal refinement or two-dimensional (2-D) cross-sectional refinement, rather than joint 3-D enhancement. Motivated by this gap, this letter proposes a U-shaped gated spatio-sequential recurrent neural network (UG-SSRNN), a spatio-sequential reconstruction model for tunnel electromagnetic fields. UG-SSRNN jointly super-resolves transverse slices and models longitudinal evolution. It uses sliding-window context encoding and a K-layer convolutional recurrent backbone with a shared propagation-context state and diagonal feedback. A prediction-aware upsampling head leverages the previous prediction to improve slice-to-slice consistency. Experiments on four tunnel cross sections, unseen-material and unseen-frequency tests, and validation in the Massif Central tunnel show close agreement with fine-mesh PWE references. The proposed approach significantly reduces tunnel electromagnetic modeling time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UG-SSRNN网络，联合超分辨横向切片与建模纵向演化，实现对隧道电磁场的三维联合增强，显著降低建模时间并保持高保真度。
AI.motivation: 细网格抛物线波动方程模拟保真度高但耗时，限制了实时隧道传播分析；现有机器学习辅助的隧道模型仅提供一维纵向或二维横向细化，缺乏三维联合增强能力。
AI.method: 提出U形门控时空序贯递归神经网络（UG-SSRNN），采用滑动窗口上下文编码和K层卷积递归主干（含共享传播上下文状态与对角反馈），并设计预测感知上采样头利用历史预测提升切片间一致性，实现横向切片超分辨与纵向演化联合建模。
AI.result: 在四种隧道截面、未见材料与未见频率测试以及Massif Central隧道验证中，该方法与细网格PWE参考结果高度吻合，显著减少了隧道电磁建模时间。
AI.conclusion: UG-SSRNN能够高效实现隧道电磁场的三维时空联合重建，在保证高保真度的前提下大幅降低计算成本，具备良好的泛化能力。
AI.abstract_zh: 细网格抛物线波动方程（PWE）模拟保真度高但耗时长，这限制了实时隧道传播分析，并促使研究者采用由粗到细的重建方法。现有的机器学习辅助隧道模型通常仅提供一维纵向细化或二维截面细化，而非三维联合增强。受此空白启发，本文提出一种U形门控时空序贯递归神经网络（UG-SSRNN），一种用于隧道电磁场的时空序贯重建模型。UG-SSRNN联合实现横向切片的超分辨与纵向演化的建模。它采用滑动窗口上下文编码和一个带有共享传播上下文状态及对角反馈的K层卷积递归主干。预测感知上采样头利用先前的预测来提升切片间的一致性。在四种隧道截面、未见材料和未见频率测试以及Massif Central隧道中的验证结果表明，该方法与细网格PWE参考结果高度吻合。所提出的方法显著减少了隧道电磁建模时间。

title: X-Palm: Paired Multispectral-to-Smartphone Dataset for Cross-Domain Palmprint Authentication
summary: Palmprint modality offers a privacy-preserving biometric solution, yet its deployment is hindered by the domain gap between controlled enrollment and unconstrained authentication. Existing datasets are largely restricted to controlled setups and fail to capture the compound variability of real-world environments. In this paper, we introduce X-Palm, a cross-domain dataset comprising 6,006 palm images from 103 individuals (206 hands). To the best of our knowledge, X-Palm is the first palmprint dataset providing novel paired-identity acquisition specifically designed to bridge the gap between reliably controlled multispectral enrollment and unconstrained mobile authentication while encompassing a broad spectrum of in-the-wild variability. Unlike existing datasets that focus on single to a few variations, X-Palm addresses the massive modality and environmental shifts encountered in practical deployments by capturing paired data for identities across two distinct domains: (1) a controlled Multispectral Palmprint setting using our custom-developed scanner, and (2) an unconstrained smartphone palmprint setting that is participant-driven, incorporating simultaneous variations in hardware, hand pose, illumination, background, camera-to-hand distance, perspective, and palm surface conditions (e.g., moisture and occlusions). Our extensive benchmarks of 12 SOTA models reveal that while existing methods achieve high performance on controlled data, they experience severe performance collapse on X-Palm. Conversely, models trained on X-Palm demonstrate consistent robustness across domains, positioning X-Palm as a valuable resource for training a model towards real-world, cross-domain generalization. Data access instructions and the related benchmarking codes are publicly available at: https://github.com/X-Palm/X-Palm-2026

AI.tldr: X-Palm是一个跨域掌纹数据集，包含103人（206只手）的6006张图像，提供配对身份数据以桥接受控多光谱采集与非约束移动采集之间的域差距。实验表明现有SOTA模型在该数据集上性能严重下降，而基于X-Palm训练的模型展现出跨域鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有掌纹数据集多局限于受控环境，无法捕捉真实世界环境的复合变化，导致掌纹识别技术在从受控注册到非约束认证的部署中面临域差距问题。作者旨在构建一个同时包含受控多光谱采集和非约束智能手机采集的配对身份数据集，以弥合这一域差距。
AI.method: 构建X-Palm跨域数据集：在受控域使用定制扫描仪进行多光谱掌纹采集，在非约束域由参与者自行拍摄智能手机掌纹图像，同时引入硬件、手部姿势、光照、背景、距离、视角和手掌表面条件等多重变化。基于12种SOTA模型进行跨域性能基准测试。
AI.result: 12种SOTA模型在受控数据上表现良好，但在X-Palm跨域场景下性能严重下降。而基于X-Palm训练的模型在两个域上均展现出持续鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: X-Palm作为首个提供配对身份跨域采集的掌纹数据集，是训练面向真实世界跨域泛化模型的重要资源。
AI.abstract_zh: 掌纹模态提供了一种保护隐私的生物识别解决方案，然而其部署受到受控注册与非约束认证之间域差距的阻碍。现有数据集大多局限于受控设置，无法捕捉真实世界环境的复合变化。本文介绍了X-Palm——一个包含来自103名个体（206只手）的6006张掌纹图像的跨域数据集。据我们所知，X-Palm是首个提供新颖的配对身份采集的掌纹数据集，专门设计用于桥接可靠受控的多光谱注册与非约束移动认证之间的差距，同时涵盖广泛的野外（in-the-wild）变化。与现有侧重于单一或少数变化的数据集不同，X-Palm通过捕获两个不同域中身份的配对数据，解决了实际部署中遇到的大规模模态和环境变化：（1）使用我们定制开发的扫描仪的受控多光谱掌纹设置，以及（2）由参与者驱动的非约束智能手机掌纹设置，该设置同时包含硬件、手部姿势、光照、背景、相机到手部距离、视角以及手掌表面条件（如湿度和遮挡）的变化。我们对12种SOTA模型的广泛基准测试表明，现有方法在受控数据上表现良好，但在X-Palm上性能严重下降。相反，基于X-Palm训练的模型在两个域上均展现出持续的鲁棒性，使X-Palm成为训练面向真实世界跨域泛化模型的宝贵资源。数据和相关基准测试代码可公开获取：https://github.com/X-Palm/X-Palm-2026

title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Adversarial Fine-tuning of Vision Transformers
summary: The widespread use of image classification models in high-risk, real-world situations necessitates making these models robust to slight disturbances or perturbations, such as blurring or sharpening, in the input images. While vision transformers (ViTs) play an integral role in many modern-day multi-modal models like Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, they have received a lack of attention in the setting of robustness. In this work, we analyze the effects of adversarial fine-tuning, a popular method for improving model robustness to image perturbations, on a ViT's performance on perturbed and regular images through a mechanistic lens. We adversarially train a ViT on low-frequency and high-frequency image corruptions, and attempt to explain changes in downstream model performance through an examination of the model's attention mechanisms, internal representations, and knowledge evolution. Overall, our results suggest that, while fine-tuning on inputs with common corruptions improves model performance and certainty on new instances of corrupted data, these improvements do not transfer to other classes of corruptions not seen in the training. Additionally, despite observing changes in visual attention and knowledge evolution across layers, we found that adversarial training did not lead to fundamental changes in the sparse representations learned by ViTs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机制分析视角，研究了对抗性微调对ViT在受扰动图像上性能的影响，发现虽然针对特定扰动的微调能提升模型在该类扰动上的表现，但这种提升无法泛化到未见过的扰动类别，且对抗训练并未改变ViT学习到的稀疏表示的本质。
AI.motivation: 图像分类模型在高风险现实场景中需要抵御输入图像的扰动（如模糊、锐化），但视觉Transformer（ViT）在鲁棒性方面的研究尚不充分，尤其缺乏对其内部机制的理解。
AI.method: 对ViT进行针对低频率和高频率图像损坏的对抗性微调，然后通过分析模型的注意力机制、内部表示和知识演化，从机制层面解释下游模型性能的变化。
AI.result: 1）对常见损坏输入进行微调能提升模型在新损坏数据上的性能和置信度，但这种提升无法迁移到训练中未见的其他损坏类别；2）尽管观察到各层的视觉注意力和知识演化发生了变化，但对抗训练并未导致ViT学习的稀疏表示发生根本性改变。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性微调对ViT鲁棒性的改善是有限的、任务特定的，无法泛化到未知扰动类型，且模型底层的稀疏表示机制并未因此发生本质变化。
AI.abstract_zh: 图像分类模型在高风险现实场景中的广泛应用，要求这些模型能够抵御输入图像中轻微扰动（如模糊或锐化）的影响。尽管视觉Transformer（ViT）在现代多模态模型（如视觉-语言模型和视觉-语言-动作模型）中扮演着不可或缺的角色，但它们在鲁棒性方面受到的关注仍然不足。本文从机制分析的视角，研究了对抗性微调（一种提升模型对图像扰动鲁棒性的常用方法）对ViT在受扰动图像和常规图像上性能的影响。我们针对低频率和高频率图像损坏对ViT进行对抗性训练，并通过分析模型的注意力机制、内部表示和知识演化，尝试解释下游模型性能变化的原因。总体而言，我们的结果表明：虽然对包含常见损坏的输入进行微调能够提升模型在新损坏数据上的性能和置信度，但这些改进无法迁移到训练中未见的其他损坏类别。此外，尽管我们观察到各层的视觉注意力和知识演化发生了变化，但对抗训练并未导致ViT学习的稀疏表示发生根本性改变。

title: Boundary Variance Inflation Causes Acquisition Bias in Gaussian Processes
summary: Gaussian processes with stationary kernels on bounded domains exhibit inflated posterior variance near the boundary. Despite being a long-recognized artifact in geostatistics and a source of over-exploration in Bayesian optimization, the causes and effects of boundary-induced acquisition bias are underexplored. We trace the root cause to a simple geometric mechanism: the truncation of the kernel correlation neighborhood at the domain boundary creates an observation-independent distortion that worsens with dimensionality. We show how this distortion manifests across three acquisition classes: variance maximization concentrates selections at the corners, whereas negative integrated posterior variance and expected predictive information gain move selections inward to axis-aligned interior shells. These patterns arise without reference to any objective function, meaning that acquisition behavior can be dominated by kernel geometry rather than the desired task-specific uncertainty. To quantify this, we introduce a function-free selection-profile diagnostic for arbitrary acquisitions, kernels, and bounded-domain geometries.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了有界域上平稳核高斯过程边界处后验方差膨胀的根本原因——核相关邻域在边界处被截断，并系统分析了这种几何失真如何导致贝叶斯优化中的三类采集偏差，最后提出了一种与目标函数无关的采集行为诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 边界引起的后验方差膨胀是地统计学中长期被认识到的伪影，也是贝叶斯优化中过度探索的来源，但其成因和影响尚未被充分探索。本文旨在揭示其根本机制并量化其对采集函数的影响。
AI.method: 从几何机制出发，论证核相关邻域在域边界截断是导致观测无关失真的根本原因，且该失真随维度增加而加剧。通过方差最大化、负积分后验方差和期望预测信息增益三类采集函数，分析边界失真的表现形式，并提出一种无需目标函数的采集选择剖面诊断工具。
AI.result: 方差最大化采集将选择集中在角落；负积分后验方差和期望预测信息增益将选择向内移至轴对齐的内部壳层。这些模式完全独立于目标函数，表明采集行为可能被核几何主导而非任务特定的不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 边界引起的采集偏差源于核相关邻域截断这一简单的几何机制，该偏差随维度增加而恶化，且会主导采集行为。提出的函数无关诊断工具可适用于任意采集函数、核函数和有界域几何。
AI.abstract_zh: 具有平稳核的高斯过程在有界域上会表现出边界附近后验方差膨胀的现象。尽管这是地统计学中一个长期被认识的伪影，也是贝叶斯优化中过度探索的一个来源，但边界引起的采集偏差的成因和影响尚未得到充分探索。我们将根本原因追溯到一个简单的几何机制：核相关邻域在域边界处被截断，产生了一种与观测无关的失真，且该失真随维度增加而加剧。我们展示了这种失真如何在三类采集函数中表现出来：方差最大化将选择集中在角落，而负积分后验方差和期望预测信息增益则将选择向内移至轴对齐的内部壳层。这些模式的出现完全不依赖于任何目标函数，意味着采集行为可能被核几何所主导，而非期望的任务特定的不确定性。为了量化这一现象，我们提出了一种无需目标函数的选择剖面诊断工具，适用于任意采集函数、核函数和有界域几何。

title: Feedforward Nonlinear Equalizer for Short- to Medium-Reach Wireline Links
summary: This paper presents a feedforward nonlinear equalizer (FFNE) framework for short- to medium-reach wireline links that removes the feedback-timing bottleneck of decision-feedback equalizers (DFEs) while approaching the noise-margin advantage within a characterized operating region. The proposed FFNE reduces short-window maximum-likelihood sequence estimation to a compact binary decision rule, enabling a low-complexity feedforward realization without transmitter-side encoding. For the single-postcursor NRZ case, the mathematical foundation, hardware implementation, tap adaptation, statistical analysis, and equalization limit relative to an ideal 1-tap DFE are established. A window-length-3 FFNE quantifies the performance-complexity tradeoff of longer sequence windows. The framework is further extended to PAM-4 modulation and simultaneous precursor/postcursor equalization through a pattern-detection-based FFNE (PD-FFNE), which outperforms conventional FFE+DFE baselines under representative channel conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种前馈非线性均衡器（FFNE）框架，用于短至中距离有线链路，消除了判决反馈均衡器（DFE）的反馈时序瓶颈，同时在特征化工作区域内接近噪声裕度优势。该框架将短窗最大似然序列估计简化为紧凑的二元判决规则，实现了无需发射端编码的低复杂度前馈实现。
AI.motivation: 消除DFE中反馈路径带来的时序瓶颈问题，同时保持接近DFE的噪声裕度优势，以适用于短至中距离有线链路的高速数据传输。
AI.method: 提出FFNE框架，将短窗最大似然序列估计简化为紧凑二元判决规则；针对单后光标NRZ情况建立数学基础、硬件实现、抽头自适应、统计分析及均衡极限；扩展至PAM-4调制和前后光标同时均衡，提出基于模式检测的FFNE（PD-FFNE）。
AI.result: 对于单后光标NRZ情况，建立了与理想1抽头DFE对比的完整理论体系；窗口长度3的FFNE量化了更长序列窗口的性能-复杂度权衡；PD-FFNE在代表性信道条件下优于传统FFE+DFE基线。
AI.conclusion: FFNE框架能够在不使用发射端编码和反馈结构的情况下，实现接近DFE性能的均衡效果，并可通过PD-FFNE扩展到更复杂的调制和均衡场景。
AI.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种前馈非线性均衡器（FFNE）框架，用于短至中距离有线链路。该框架消除了判决反馈均衡器（DFE）的反馈时序瓶颈，同时在特征化工作区域内接近噪声裕度优势。所提出的FFNE将短窗最大似然序列估计简化为紧凑的二元判决规则，实现了无需发射端编码的低复杂度前馈实现。针对单后光标不归零（NRZ）情况，建立了数学基础、硬件实现、抽头自适应、统计分析及与理想1抽头DFE对比的均衡极限。窗口长度为3的FFNE量化了更长序列窗口的性能-复杂度权衡。该框架进一步扩展至PAM-4调制以及基于模式检测的FFNE（PD-FFNE）实现前后光标同时均衡，在代表性信道条件下优于传统FFE+DFE基线方案。

title: Active Source-free Domain Adaptation in Open-set Medical Image Segmentation via Decomposed Uncertainty and Prototype Discrepancy
comment: Early accepted by MICCAI 2026. This version is not the Version of Record and does not reflect post-acceptance improvements, or any corrections
summary: Deep learning (DL) methods are challenged to demonstrate robust performance across different segmentation datasets due to domain shifts, but active domain adaptation techniques enhance their generalization performance by querying a few samples from target domains for adaptation training. However in clinical practice, target domains often include private classes of new anatomical structures or pathologies that are not presented in the source data, and existing methods implement closed-set segmentation where source and target domains have the same segmentation classes. Additionally, source data are often inaccessible during adaptation due to strict data privacy regulations. To address these limitations, we propose an Active Source-free Open-set Domain Adaptation (ASFOSDA) method which is the first work to implement active learning for adapting DL models in open-set medical image segmentation without the access to source data. This method employs an active open-set query strategy to select the most informative target samples for training models based on Class-aware Decomposed Uncertainty (CDU) and Class-agnostic Prototype Discrepancy (CPD). CDU measures sample aleatoric uncertainty and model epistemic uncertainty by employing test time augmentation in stochastic processes. CPD measures cross-domain and self-domain discrepancy for selecting diverse samples. Subsequently, to boost the adaptation performance by enhancing training samples, a Target-refined Self-training strategy is proposed to generate high-quality pseudo labels for unselected samples, thus combining them with labeled samples for a semi-supervised training. We evaluated our method on cross-domain open-set volumetric medical image segmentation tasks, and it outperformed state-of-the-art adaptation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出主动源自由开放集域适应（ASFOSDA）方法，用于无源数据访问的开放集医学图像分割，通过主动查询策略和半监督自训练，在跨域体积分割任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有主动域适应方法仅限于封闭集场景（源域和目标域类别相同），且需访问源数据，但在临床实践中目标域常包含源域未出现的新类别（开放集），且源数据因隐私法规不可用。本文旨在解决这些限制。
AI.method: 提出ASFOSDA方法，包含：(1) 主动开放集查询策略，基于类别感知分解不确定性（CDU）和类别无关原型差异（CPD）选择最具信息量的目标样本；(2) 目标精炼自训练策略，为未选中样本生成高质量伪标签，结合标注样本进行半监督训练。
AI.result: 在跨域开放集体积医学图像分割任务上，该方法优于最先进的域适应方法。
AI.conclusion: ASFOSDA方法通过主动学习与半监督自训练的结合，有效解决了源数据不可用条件下的开放集医学图像分割问题，为临床应用提供了可行方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 深度学习方法因域偏移而在不同分割数据集上难以展现稳健性能，但主动域适应技术通过从目标域中查询少量样本进行适应训练来增强其泛化能力。然而在临床实践中，目标域常包含源数据中未出现的新解剖结构或病理的私有类别，而现有方法实现的是源域与目标域具有相同分割类别的封闭集分割。此外，由于严格的数据隐私法规，适应过程中通常无法访问源数据。为解决这些限制，我们提出了一种主动源自由开放集域适应（ASFOSDA）方法，这是首个在无源数据访问条件下，将主动学习应用于开放集医学图像分割模型适应的工作。该方法采用主动开放集查询策略，基于类别感知分解不确定性（CDU）和类别无关原型差异（CPD）选择最具信息量的目标样本来训练模型。CDU通过随机过程中的测试时增强来测量样本的偶然不确定性和模型的认知不确定性。CPD通过衡量跨域和域内差异来选择多样化的样本。随后，为增强训练样本以提升适应性能，我们提出了一种目标精炼自训练策略，为未选中的样本生成高质量的伪标签，从而将其与标注样本结合进行半监督训练。我们在跨域开放集体积医学图像分割任务上评估了该方法，其性能优于最先进的域适应方法。

title: VisualLeakBench: Reproducible Action-Boundary Propagation Failures in Vision-Language Agents
summary: Vision-language agents increasingly consume screenshots, documents, and user interfaces before writing to memory, sending messages, or invoking external tools. We study a concrete failure mode in this setting: action-boundary propagation, where sensitive or unsafe visible text is copied from an image into downstream tool arguments. We present VisualLeakBench, a diversified 500-image benchmark spanning UI, chat, document, form, and dashboard scenes, and evaluate a stratified 100-image agent subset with four production VLM systems under two workflows: note capture and external handoff. At baseline, target strings are propagated into tool arguments in 78.8% of PII cases and 85.5% of rendered unsafe-text cases. Under a defensive system prompt, rendered unsafe-text propagation remains high at 52.6%, while PII tool propagation falls to 2.0%, largely by suppressing tool use rather than preserving utility. Rates are tool-surface dependent: search-like tools suppress PII propagation, but rendered unsafe text still crosses tool boundaries. We measure visual-to-tool propagation rather than downstream instruction execution. We additionally provide a labeled-target oracle upper-bound diagnostic that localizes most failures at the tool boundary while leaving response-side leakage as residual risk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉-语言智能体在读取图像后，将其中敏感或危险文本复制到下游工具参数中的“动作边界传播”失败模式，并提出了VisualLeakBench基准来量化该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言智能体在执行截图、文档等图像理解任务时，会将图像中的敏感文本传递到工具调用参数中，导致隐私泄露或安全风险，但目前缺乏系统性的评估基准来分析这一失败模式。
AI.method: 构建了包含500张图像（涵盖UI、聊天、文档、表单、仪表盘五种场景）的VisualLeakBench基准，选取100张图像的子集，在两种工作流（笔记捕获和外部交接）下，使用四种生产级VLM系统进行测试。通过防御性系统提示和标注目标的oracle上界诊断来分析视觉到工具的传播行为。
AI.result: 基线设置下，PII目标字符串在78.8%的案例中被传播到工具参数，渲染危险文本为85.5%。防御性提示使PII传播降至2.0%（主要通过抑制工具使用），但渲染危险文本传播仍高达52.6%。工具表面依赖性明显：搜索类工具抑制PII传播，但渲染危险文本仍跨越工具边界。
AI.conclusion: 视觉-语言智能体存在严重的动作边界传播风险，防御性提示对PII有效但对渲染危险文本效果有限，且以牺牲工具可用性为代价。主要失败发生在工具边界，响应侧泄漏是残余风险。
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言智能体越来越多地消费截图、文档和用户界面，然后写入内存、发送消息或调用外部工具。我们研究了这一设置中的一种具体失败模式：动作边界传播（action-boundary propagation），即敏感或危险的可见文本从图像中被复制到下游工具参数中。我们提出了VisualLeakBench，一个涵盖UI、聊天、文档、表单和仪表盘场景的多样化500图像基准，并在两个工作流（笔记捕获和外部交接）下，使用四种生产级VLM系统对分层抽样的100图像智能体子集进行评估。在基线设置下，目标字符串在78.8%的PII案例和85.5%的渲染危险文本案例中被传播到工具参数中。在使用防御性系统提示时，渲染危险文本的传播率仍高达52.6%，而PII的工具传播率降至2.0%，这主要通过抑制工具使用而非保持实用性来实现。传播率依赖于工具表面：类似搜索的工具抑制了PII传播，但渲染危险文本仍然跨越工具边界。我们衡量的是视觉到工具的传播，而非下游指令执行。我们还提供了一个带标注目标的oracle上界诊断，将大多数失败定位在工具边界，而将响应侧泄漏作为残余风险。

title: Emergence via Phase Transitions: Mechanism Landscapes and Universal Convergence Across Complex Systems
comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables; 15-page Supplementary Information with complete proofs included
summary: Across machine learning, biology, and physics, independently evolving systems often converge toward strikingly similar high-level structures despite radically different microscopic details. Grokking circuits converge across random seeds, evolutionary lineages rediscover similar metabolic solutions, and renormalization flows approach common fixed points. We propose the Hierarchical Emergence Framework (HEF) as a candidate universality framework for such convergence phenomena. HEF models emergence as a phase transition in a mechanism landscape constrained by thermodynamic and information-theoretic laws. The framework introduces a critical energy threshold Ec separating an exploration regime with competing mechanisms from a convergence regime governed by a unique minimum-cost mechanism. Under structural assumptions, we prove physical feasibility, derive strict metric contraction, and establish convergence toward a unique fixed-point representation independent of initial conditions. We further connect this convergence structure to causal emergence through Effective Information and mechanism competition entropy. To test the framework, we study delayed generalization ("grokking") in modular arithmetic transformers across 111 experiments. We identify a reproducible empirical fingerprint of the Ec transition: the weight norm peaks systematically before grokking in 92% of runs. Normalized accuracy curves collapse onto a tanh kink (R^2=0.93) consistent with a Landau-Ginzburg universality class, and all grokked models converge to 0.9745+/-0.014 regardless of initialization, weight decay, or training fraction (ANOVA p>0.13). HEF is not presented as a universal theory of emergence, but as a falsifiable mathematical scaffold for studying convergence phenomena across complex systems.

AI.tldr: 提出层级涌现框架（HEF），将涌现建模为机制景观中的相变，通过临界能量阈值Ec区分探索与收敛机制。在111个模算术变换器实验中发现权值范数在grokking前系统性峰值、精度曲线塌缩为tanh扭结等经验指纹，验证了该框架的预测。
AI.motivation: 解释跨机器学习、生物学和物理学中独立演化系统趋向于相似高层结构这一普遍现象（如grokking电路收敛、进化路径重现代谢解、重整化流趋近固定点），为这类收敛现象提供一个统一的数学框架。
AI.method: 提出层级涌现框架（HEF），将涌现建模为受热力学和信息论约束的机制景观中的相变。引入临界能量阈值Ec，区分探索机制竞争阶段与唯一最小成本机制主导的收敛阶段。在结构假设下证明物理可行性、严格度量收缩以及独立于初始条件收敛到唯一不动点，并通过有效信息（EI）和机制竞争熵连接因果涌现结构。
AI.result: 在111个模算术变换器的延迟泛化（grokking）实验中，92%的实验中观察到权值范数在grokking前系统性达到峰值的Ec转变指纹；归一化精度曲线以R²=0.93塌缩为tanh kink，符合朗道-金兹堡普适类；所有grokked模型收敛到0.9745±0.014，不受初始化、权重衰减或训练分数影响（ANOVA p>0.13）。
AI.conclusion: HEF并非作为涌现的普适理论提出，而是为跨复杂系统的收敛现象研究提供一个可证伪的数学框架。
AI.abstract_zh: 在机器学习、生物学和物理学中，独立演化的系统尽管微观细节截然不同，却常常趋同于高度相似的高层结构。Grokking电路在不同随机种子下收敛，进化谱系重新发现类似的代谢解决方案，重整化流趋近共同的固定点。我们提出层级涌现框架（HEF）作为这类收敛现象的候选普适性框架。HEF将涌现建模为受热力学和信息论约束的机制景观中的相变。该框架引入一个临界能量阈值Ec，将机制竞争探索阶段与唯一最小成本机制主导的收敛阶段区分开来。在结构假设下，我们证明了物理可行性、严格度量收缩，以及独立于初始条件收敛到唯一不动点表示。我们进一步通过有效信息（Effective Information）和机制竞争熵将这一收敛结构与因果涌现联系起来。为了测试该框架，我们在111个实验中研究了模算术变换器的延迟泛化（"grokking"）。我们识别出一个可复现的Ec转变经验指纹：在92%的运行中，权值范数在grokking之前系统性地达到峰值。归一化精度曲线塌缩为一个tanh扭结（R²=0.93），符合朗道-金兹堡普适类，并且所有grokked模型收敛到0.9745±0.014，不受初始化、权重衰减或训练分数的影响（ANOVA p>0.13）。HEF并非作为涌现的普适理论提出，而是作为研究跨复杂系统收敛现象的一个可证伪的数学框架。

title: Enhanced Wide-Angle Steering with Multi-Mode Multi-Port Aperture Antenna Arrays
summary: A novel concept for wide-angle scanning is proposed based on multi-mode multi-port antennas. The theory of multi-mode multi-port antennas based on aperture radiators is developed and applied towards the design of an antenna array consisting of multi-mode aperture radiators. An advanced beamforming algorithm is developed and implemented, making use of the higher degrees of freedom available to multi-mode multi-port antennas. The manufactured antenna array is measured and compared to the expected performance. Wide-angle steering up to $\pm77^\circ$ from broadside with respect to a scan loss of $3\,\mathrm{dB}$ is achieved in both the horizontal and vertical plane with no visible grating lobe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多模多端口天线的宽角度扫描新概念，通过开发孔径辐射体多模多端口天线理论、设计天线阵列并实现先进波束赋形算法，在水平与垂直平面上均实现了扫描角度达±77°（相对于3 dB扫描损耗）且无可见栅瓣的宽角扫描性能。
AI.motivation: 传统天线阵列在宽角度扫描时容易出现栅瓣和扫描损耗过大的问题，限制了扫描范围。为了突破这一瓶颈，需要利用更高自由度的天线结构来实现更大角度的无栅瓣扫描。
AI.method: 首先，基于孔径辐射体发展了多模多端口天线理论；然后，利用多模孔径辐射体设计天线阵列；最后，开发并实现了一种先进的波束赋形算法，充分利用多模多端口天线提供的更高自由度来优化波束指向。
AI.result: 制造的天线阵列在水平面和垂直面均实现了从法向到±77°的宽角扫描（相对于3 dB扫描损耗），且未出现可见的栅瓣。
AI.conclusion: 基于多模多端口孔径辐射体的天线阵列能够有效实现宽角无栅瓣扫描，验证了所提理论和算法的可行性与有效性。
AI.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于多模多端口天线的宽角度扫描新概念。发展了基于孔径辐射体的多模多端口天线理论，并将其应用于由多模孔径辐射体组成的天线阵列设计。开发并实现了一种先进的波束赋形算法，充分利用多模多端口天线提供的更高自由度。对制造的天线阵列进行了测试，并将结果与预期性能进行了比较。在水平面和垂直面上，相对于3 dB扫描损耗，均实现了从法向到±77°的宽角扫描，且未出现可见的栅瓣。

title: Dynamic XR Rendering Offloading Based on Feature-Based Quality Assessment
summary: Extended Reality (XR) applications demand intensive computation and low latency, especially for real-time rendering tasks. In this letter, we present an edge-aided XR rendering testbed that dynamically offloads rendering workloads between the XR client and the edge server built upon network conditions and latency constraints. The testbed integrates a Microsoft HoloLens 2 headset, a GPU-enabled edge server, and a customized remote rendering toolkit based on the HOLO Stream SDK, enabling seamless switching between local and edge rendering modes in real time. To overcome the limitations of pixel-level quality metrics under head movements and asynchronous frame arrivals, we propose a perceptual evaluation metric based on deep feature embeddings and cosine similarity, which remains robust to spatial and temporal misalignments. Furthermore, we design a contextual bandit learning controller to adapt rendering placement decisions in real time by jointly optimizing perceptual quality and latency. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility and performance of our testbed, validating its effectiveness in delivering high-quality and interactive XR experiences.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种边缘辅助的XR渲染测试平台，通过上下文强盗学习控制器动态优化渲染卸载决策，并设计了一种基于深度特征嵌入和余弦相似度的感知质量评估指标，在真实测试中验证了其有效性与交互性能。
AI.motivation: 扩展现实（XR）应用对计算和延迟要求极高，尤其是在实时渲染任务中，现有方法难以在本地渲染与边缘渲染之间实现动态、自适应的卸载决策，同时缺乏对头部运动和异步帧到达下感知质量的鲁棒评估指标。
AI.method: 1）构建了集成HoloLens 2头显、GPU边缘服务器和基于HOLO Stream SDK的自定义远程渲染工具包的测试平台；2）提出基于深度特征嵌入和余弦相似度的感知评价指标，对空间和时间错位具有鲁棒性；3）设计上下文强盗学习控制器，联合优化感知质量和延迟，实时自适应调整渲染放置决策。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该测试平台在提供高质量、可交互的XR体验方面具有可行性和有效性，验证了动态渲染卸载和自适应决策机制的实际性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的边缘辅助XR渲染测试平台能够根据网络条件和延迟约束动态卸载渲染任务，结合鲁棒的感知质量指标和自适应学习控制器，有效提升了XR应用的实时交互体验质量。
AI.abstract_zh: 扩展现实（XR）应用对计算和低延迟有极高要求，尤其是在实时渲染任务中。本文提出了一种边缘辅助的XR渲染测试平台，该平台能够根据网络条件和延迟约束，在XR客户端与边缘服务器之间动态卸载渲染工作负载。该测试平台集成了Microsoft HoloLens 2头显、支持GPU的边缘服务器以及基于HOLO Stream SDK定制的远程渲染工具包，能够实时无缝切换本地渲染与边缘渲染模式。为克服头部运动和异步帧到达条件下像素级质量指标的局限性，我们提出了一种基于深度特征嵌入和余弦相似度的感知评价指标，该指标对空间和时间错位具有鲁棒性。此外，我们设计了一个上下文强盗学习控制器，通过联合优化感知质量和延迟，实时自适应调整渲染放置决策。实验结果证明了该测试平台的可行性和性能，验证了其在提供高质量、可交互的XR体验方面的有效性。

title: Can You Trust What You See? Human and AI Detection of Synthetic Legal Evidence
summary: Visual evidence has long been treated as a reliable form of legal proof, but advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are undermining that assumption. This article asks how well humans and frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can distinguish authentic evidentiary photographs from AI-generated counterparts in the object-centric scenarios typical of civil disputes. We built Synthetic Legal Evidence Detection (SLED-1400), a dataset of 200 authentic evidence images paired with 1,200 synthetic counterparts produced by six contemporary text-to-image generators across ten evidence categories. The same stimuli and response format were used in a controlled web experiment with 136 lay participants and in a standardized evaluation of four MLLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini-3-Pro, Gemini-3-Flash, Qwen3-VL-235B). Human accuracy was 64.8% overall, and 48.5% and 51.0% on the two strongest generators (Gemini-3-Pro-Image and Flux-2-Max), indistinguishable from chance. MLLMs never misclassified an authentic image (100% specificity), but missed most synthetic outputs from the harder generators, with average MLLM detection at 5.9% on Gemini-3-Pro-Image outputs. Human and MLLM errors were largely uncorrelated, while the four MLLMs were strongly correlated with each other. Neither group is a reliable standalone authenticator. We argue that visual evidence in legal proceedings should be treated as inherently contestable, and that a workable procedural response must combine trained human review, MLLM screening, and provenance infrastructure such as C2PA Content Credentials.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了人类和前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在民事纠纷常见的以物体为中心的视觉证据中，区分真实照片与AI生成图像的能力。实验发现人类准确率仅64.8%，MLLM虽能100%识别真实图像但漏检大量AI生成图像，两者均不可作为独立认证工具，需结合人工审查、MLLM筛查和溯源基础设施。
AI.motivation: 长期以来视觉证据被视为可靠的法庭证明形式，但AI生成技术的进步正在动摇这一假设。本文旨在检验人类和前沿多模态大语言模型能否有效区分真实证据照片与AI生成的伪造图像。
AI.method: 构建了SLED-1400数据集（200张真实证据图像+1200张由6种文本到图像生成器合成的图像，涵盖10个证据类别）；通过受控网络实验（136名非专业参与者）和标准化评估（4种MLLM：GPT-5.1、Gemini-3-Pro、Gemini-3-Flash、Qwen3-VL-235B）进行对比测试。
AI.result: 人类总体准确率64.8%，在最强生成器（Gemini-3-Pro-Image和Flux-2-Max）上准确率仅48.5%和51.0%，与随机猜测无异；MLLM对真实图像100%特异度，但对较难生成器合成的图像平均检测率仅5.9%；人类与MLLM的错误模式基本不相关，而各MLLM之间高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 人类和MLLM均不可作为可靠的独立认证工具。视觉证据在法律程序中应被视为内在可质疑的，可行的程序性应对措施需结合训练有素的人工审查、MLLM筛查以及C2PA Content Credentials等溯源基础设施。
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉证据长期以来被视为一种可靠的法庭证明形式，但人工智能（AI）的进步正在削弱这一假设。本文探究了在民事纠纷中常见的以物体为中心的场景下，人类和前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）区分真实证据照片与AI生成对应图像的能力。我们构建了合成法律证据检测数据集（SLED-1400），该数据集包含200张真实证据图像及由六种当代文本到图像生成器生成的1200张合成对应图像，涵盖十个证据类别。我们在受控网络实验中以相同的刺激和响应格式对136名非专业参与者进行了测试，并对四种MLLM（GPT-5.1、Gemini-3-Pro、Gemini-3-Flash、Qwen3-VL-235B）进行了标准化评估。人类总体准确率为64.8%，在两个最强生成器（Gemini-3-Pro-Image和Flux-2-Max）上的准确率分别为48.5%和51.0%，与随机猜测无异。MLLM从未错误分类过真实图像（100%特异度），但漏检了大部分来自较难生成器的合成输出，MLLM对Gemini-3-Pro-Image输出的平均检测率仅为5.9%。人类和MLLM的错误模式基本不相关，而四种MLLM之间则高度相关。两个群体均不能作为可靠的独立认证工具。我们认为，法律程序中的视觉证据应被视为内在可质疑的，而可行的程序性应对措施必须结合训练有素的人工审查、MLLM筛查以及C2PA Content Credentials等溯源基础设施。

title: STARIXNet: Multivariate and Multi-attribute Deep Learning Approach to Real-Time Resource Allocation in Cloud Platforms
summary: Intelligent scaling of microservices in cloud platforms is crucial for mitigating escalating compute costs while avoiding service disruptions. Current solutions are limited to the univariate space, typically focusing on CPU usage alone to drive scaling decisions. Moreover, they address the problem as a purely forecasting task, focusing on prediction precision while neglecting the greater risks of underestimation and delays in system responsiveness. Alternative solutions are computationally complex, making them impractical for large-scale, real-time deployments. To address these challenges, we present STARIXNet, a lightweight neural network that guides resource allocation decisions in the multivariate space by capturing spatio-temporal relationships among multiple system metrics. STARIXNet models multiple quasi-dependent attributes, in particular the (S)easonal, (T)emporal, (A)uto-(R)egressive (I)ntegrated, and e(X)ogenous patterns, then implements an aggregation policy to finalize scaling decisions, prioritizing service stability, followed by cost-efficiency, over raw forecast accuracy. We empirically demonstrate the performance of STARIXNet by benchmarking against existing solutions in real-world settings. STARIXNet is deployed for critical production microservices at Walmart achieving tangible savings ranging from 10\% to 50\%, in addition to intangible benefits through improved service stability and customer experience.

AI.tldr: STARIXNet是一种轻量级神经网络，通过捕获多系统指标间的时空关系来指导微服务的多维资源扩缩容决策，在沃尔玛生产环境中实现了10%-50%的成本节约，并提升了服务稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有云平台微服务扩缩容方案存在三个局限：①局限于单变量空间（仅依赖CPU使用率）；②将问题视为纯预测任务，忽视低估风险和系统响应延迟；③替代方案计算复杂，难以大规模实时部署。
AI.method: STARIXNet是一个轻量级神经网络，在多元空间中捕获多个系统指标间的时空关系，建模季节性(S)、时间性(T)、自回归整合(ARI)和外生变量(X)模式，然后通过聚合策略做出扩缩容决策，优先保障服务稳定性，其次是成本效率，最后才是原始预测精度。
AI.result: 在沃尔玛关键生产微服务中部署，实现了10%到50%的实际成本节约，同时带来服务稳定性和客户体验提升的无形收益。
AI.conclusion: STARIXNet通过在多元空间中建模多个准依赖属性的时空关系，实现了更优的微服务扩缩容决策，在成本节约和服务稳定性之间取得了更好平衡。
AI.abstract_zh: 云平台中微服务的智能扩缩容对于缓解日益增长的计算成本同时避免服务中断至关重要。现有方案局限于单变量空间，通常仅依赖CPU使用率来驱动扩缩容决策。此外，它们将问题视为纯粹的预测任务，关注预测精度而忽视低估风险和系统响应延迟的更大风险。替代方案计算复杂，使其难以应用于大规模实时部署。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了STARIXNet，一种轻量级神经网络，通过捕获多个系统指标间的时空关系来指导多元空间中的资源分配决策。STARIXNet对多个准依赖属性进行建模，特别是季节性(S)、时间性(T)、自回归整合(ARI)和外生变量(X)模式，然后实施聚合策略以最终确定扩缩容决策，优先保障服务稳定性，其次是成本效率，最后才是原始预测精度。我们通过在真实环境中对现有方案进行基准测试，实证证明了STARIXNet的性能。STARIXNet目前已部署在沃尔玛的关键生产微服务中，实现了10%到50%的实际成本节约，并通过改进的服务稳定性和客户体验带来了无形收益。

title: A Switching Beamformer for Highly Non-Stationary Environments
summary: Adaptive beamforming is a cornerstone of array signal processing, yet its performance often collapses in the face of complex, rapidly changing interference. When interferers appear or move unpredictably, conventional estimators encounter a fundamental memory trade-off: short windows enable rapid tracking but suffer from high estimation variance, while long windows provide stable rejection but fail to adapt to shifts. This challenge is resolved by introducing the Universal Switching Beamformer (USB), which integrates competitive sequential prediction into the beamforming architecture. By employing a linear transition diagram, the USB implicitly maintains an exponentially large family of candidate covariance histories and dynamically re-weights them based on their cumulative output power. This mechanism allows the beamformer to automatically vary its effective memory length without explicit change detection or heuristic parameter tuning. A theoretical upper bound is proven on the regret relative to an omniscient oracle that selects the best piecewise-stationary covariance model in hindsight. Extensive simulations and experiments on the SwellEx-96 dataset demonstrate that the USB achieves the agility of short-window estimators and the precision of long-term integration, providing a principled solution for tracking highly non-stationary scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出通用切换波束形成器（USB），通过集成竞争性序列预测，在不依赖显式变化检测或启发式调参的情况下，自动调整有效记忆长度，在高度非平稳干扰环境中同时实现快速跟踪与稳定抑制，并从理论上证明了其后悔上界。
AI.motivation: 传统自适应波束形成器在面对复杂、快速变化的干扰时性能急剧下降：短窗估计方差大，长窗无法适应干扰变化，存在固有的记忆权衡问题。
AI.method: 将竞争性序列预测集成到波束形成架构中。通过线性转移图隐式维护指数级数量的候选协方差历史，并根据累积输出功率动态重新加权，从而自动调整有效记忆长度。
AI.result: 理论证明了相对于最优分段平稳协方差oracle的后悔上界；在SwellEx-96数据集上的仿真和实验表明，USB兼具短窗估计器的敏捷性和长窗估计器的精确性。
AI.conclusion: USB为跟踪高度非平稳场景提供了原则性解决方案，在不牺牲稳态性能的前提下实现了对快速变化干扰的适应性。
AI.abstract_zh: 自适应波束形成是阵列信号处理的基石，但其性能在面对复杂、快速变化的干扰时常常崩溃。当干扰源不可预测地出现或移动时，传统估计器面临一个根本性的记忆权衡：短窗口可实现快速跟踪，但估计方差大；长窗口提供稳定的抑制，但无法适应变化。本文通过将竞争性序列预测集成到波束形成架构中，提出了通用切换波束形成器（USB）来应对这一挑战。通过采用线性转移图，USB隐式维护了一个指数级庞大的候选协方差历史族，并根据其累积输出功率动态地重新加权。该机制使波束形成器能够自动改变其有效记忆长度，无需显式变化检测或启发式参数调优。本文证明了相对于一个全知oracle（在事后选择最佳分段平稳协方差模型）的后悔理论上界。在SwellEx-96数据集上的大量仿真和实验表明，USB兼具短窗估计器的敏捷性和长窗积分估计器的精确性，为跟踪高度非平稳场景提供了一种原则性解决方案。

title: Vendor-agnostic 4D Phase Contrast MRI: a complete open-source pipeline for velocities, displacement, and strain analysis
summary: Phase contrast MRI (PC MRI) enables quantitative assessment of tissue motion and strain. Although it is increasingly used, standardized, vendor-agnostic pipelines for accelerated acquisitions remain scarce. We present a fully open-source 4D flow PC-MRI pipeline integrating a compressed sensing-accelerated sequence implemented in PyPulseq, BART-based reconstruction, and strain analysis. Additionally, a gradient probing sequence was developed to ensure correct velocity sign assignment across scanner orientations and vendors. The pipeline was validated across two Siemens MRI systems (3T MAGNETOM Prisma and 3T Vida Fit) in two anatomical applications: forearm (Flexor Digitorum Superficialis, n=9) and thigh (Vastus Lateralis, n=10) during Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation (NMES)-induced contractions. Compressed sensing reduced acquisition times from 35 and 80 minutes to 5 and 11 minutes for the arm and leg acquisitions, respectively. Muscle strain maps and sigmoid-fitted strain curves enabled extraction of peak strain, mean strain, and buildup rate. Strains in the Vastus Lateralis were approximately one order of magnitude higher than in the Flexor Digitorum Superficialis (median peak strain 0.49 vs. 0.063, mean strain 0.31 vs. 0.031). The pipeline demonstrates multi-platform compatibility and provides a reproducible, open framework for quantitative muscle imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个完全开源的4D flow PC-MRI管线，集成了PyPulseq实现的压缩感知加速序列、BART重建和应变分析。该管线在两种西门子MRI系统上验证，将手臂和腿部采集时间从35/80分钟分别缩短至5/11分钟，并成功提取了肌肉应变参数。
AI.motivation: 虽然相位对比MRI（PC MRI）在组织运动和应变定量评估中日益普及，但目前仍缺乏标准化、跨厂商的加速采集开源管线，现有方案难以实现不同平台间的可重复性和兼容性。
AI.method: 开发了一套完全开源的4D flow PC-MRI管线，包括：(1) 基于PyPulseq实现压缩感知加速序列；(2) 基于BART进行图像重建；(3) 应变分析模块；(4) 梯度探测序列确保不同扫描仪方向和厂商间速度符号的正确分配。在两种西门子MRI系统（Prisma和Vida Fit）上，分别对前臂（指浅屈肌，n=9）和大腿（股外侧肌，n=10）在神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）诱发的收缩中进行验证。
